Einmalige und sitzungsgebundene Freigaben für Prozessausführung.\n//!\n//! Ein [`ProcessPermit`] ist bewusst kein Tool-Argument und kein konfigurierbarer\n//! Sandbox-Schalter. Er wird von der Runtime vor der Ausführung ausgestellt und\n//! vom syscall-nahen Executor atomar verbraucht beziehungsweise geprüft. Damit\n//! kann ein Modell weder einen Permit aus JSON erzeugen noch einen Permit für\n//! einen anderen Befehl, Worker oder Workspace wiederverwenden.\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\n\n/// Umgebung, die ein genehmigter Prozess benutzen darf.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ProcessEnvironment {\n    /// Normale isolierte Bubblewrap-Ausführung.\n    StrictSandbox,\n    /// Isolierte Ausführung mit dem vorher konfigurierten Cargo-Modul.\n    CargoSandbox,\n    /// Isolierte Ausführung mit einem einzelnen validierten tmux-Socket.\n    TmuxInspection,\n    /// Lokale Host-Ausführung; nur nach UI-Approval möglich.\n    LocalHost,\n}\n\n/// Lebensdauer einer durch die lokale UI bestätigten Host-Freigabe.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum HostApprovalScope {\n    /// Ein Permit darf nur genau einen Auftrag ausführen.\n    SingleExecution,\n    /// Mehrere Aufträge derselben lokalen Sitzung dürfen bis Ablauf des Leases\n    /// Host-Ausführung beantragen. Jeder Auftrag wird trotzdem gegen Worker,\n    /// Workspace und Umgebung geprüft.\n    SessionLease,\n}\n\n/// Nicht erratbare Kennung eines Runtime-ausgestellten Permits.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord, Hash)]\npub struct ProcessPermitId(u64);\n\n/// Der unveränderliche Bindungsgegenstand einer Prozessfreigabe.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ProcessPermitRequest {\n    /// Lokale Parent-Sitzung, für die die UI zugestimmt hat.\n    pub session: String,\n    /// Exakte eingebettete Worker-Definition, nicht nur deren Organisationsrolle.\n    pub worker_definition: String,\n    /// Kanonischer Prozessauftrag. Für Shell-Aufträge ist dies der exakt an\n    /// `/bin/sh -c` zu übergebende Text.\n    pub command: String,\n    /// Bereits kanonische Workspace-Wurzel.\n    pub workspace: PathBuf,\n    /// Gewünschte, enge Prozessumgebung.\n    pub environment: ProcessEnvironment,\n}\n\nimpl ProcessPermitRequest {\n    /// Prüft ausschließlich die strukturellen Invarianten eines Antrags.\n    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<(), ProcessPermitError> {\n        if self.session.trim().is_empty()\n            || self.worker_definition.trim().is_empty()\n            || self.command.trim().is_empty()\n        {\n            return Err(ProcessPermitError::InvalidRequest);\n        }\n        if !self.workspace.is_absolute() {\n            return Err(ProcessPermitError::WorkspaceNotAbsolute);\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Ergebnis einer erfolgreichen Permit-Prüfung; nur der Ledger kann es erzeugen.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct GrantedProcessPermit {\n    id: ProcessPermitId,\n    request: ProcessPermitRequest,\n    scope: HostApprovalScope,\n}\n\nimpl GrantedProcessPermit {\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn id(&self) -> ProcessPermitId {\n        self.id\n    }\n\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn request(&self) -> &ProcessPermitRequest {\n        &self.request\n    }\n\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn scope(&self) -> HostApprovalScope {\n        self.scope\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\nstruct StoredPermit {\n    request: ProcessPermitRequest,\n    scope: HostApprovalScope,\n    expires_at: Instant,\n    consumed: bool,\n}\n\n/// Runtime-eigene, nebenläufig sichere Freigabe-Registry.\n///\n/// Die Registry ist der Durchsetzungspunkt für Einmaligkeit und Ablauf. Ihre\n/// Ausstellungsfunktionen gehören an die lokale UI-Approval-Grenze; ein Modell\n/// erhält nur eine Kennung, niemals eine Möglichkeit, einen Eintrag zu erzeugen.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct ProcessPermitLedger {\n    state: Mutex<PermitState>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\nstruct PermitState {\n    next_id: u64,\n    permits: BTreeMap<ProcessPermitId, StoredPermit>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ProcessPermitLedger {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            state: Mutex::new(PermitState {\n                next_id: 1,\n                permits: BTreeMap::new(),\n            }),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ProcessPermitLedger {\n    /// Stellt nach einer lokalen UI-Entscheidung eine Freigabe aus.\n    ///\n    /// `SessionLease` ist nur für `LocalHost` gültig. Damit kann eine normale\n    /// Cargo- oder tmux-Modulfreigabe nicht versehentlich zur längeren\n    /// Host-Arbeitsphase werden.\n    pub fn issue_after_local_approval(\n        &self,\n        request: ProcessPermitRequest,\n        scope: HostApprovalScope,\n        ttl: Duration,\n    ) -> Result<ProcessPermitId, ProcessPermitError> {\n        request.validate()?;\n        if ttl.is_zero() {\n            return Err(ProcessPermitError::ZeroTtl);\n        }\n        if scope == HostApprovalScope::SessionLease\n            && request.environment != ProcessEnvironment::LocalHost\n        {\n            return Err(ProcessPermitError::SessionLeaseRequiresHost);\n        }\n        let expires_at = Instant::now()\n            .checked_add(ttl)\n            .ok_or(ProcessPermitError::TtlOverflow)?;\n        let mut state = self.state.lock().map_err(|_| ProcessPermitError::Poisoned)?;\n        let id = ProcessPermitId(state.next_id);\n        state.next_id = state.next_id.checked_add(1).ok_or(ProcessPermitError::IdExhausted)?;\n        state.permits.insert(\n            id,\n            StoredPermit {\n                request,\n                scope,\n                expires_at,\n                consumed: false,\n            },\n        );\n        Ok(id)\n    }\n\n    /// Prüft die vollständige Bindung und verbraucht Einmal-Permits atomar.\n    ///\n    /// Bei `SessionLease` bleibt der Eintrag bis Ablauf erhalten, aber nur ein\n    /// exakt gleicher Auftrag darf ihn verwenden. Unbekannte Kennungen sind\n    /// absichtlich idempotent.\n    pub fn revoke(&self, id: ProcessPermitId) -> Result<(), ProcessPermitError> {\n        self.state\n            .lock()\n            .map_err(|_| ProcessPermitError::Poisoned)?\n            .permits\n            .remove(&id);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Widerruft sämtliche Permits einer Sitzung. Der Stringvergleich ist\n    /// absichtlich exakt; keine Präfix- oder Teiltreffer dürfen fremde Sessions\n    /// beeinflussen.\n    pub fn revoke_session(&self, session: &str) -> Result<usize, ProcessPermitError> {\n        let mut state = self.state.lock().map_err(|_| ProcessPermitError::Poisoned)?;\n        let before = state.permits.len();\n        state.permits.retain(|_, permit| permit.request.session != session);\n        Ok(before - state.permits.len())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Fail-closed Fehler der Permit-Grenze. SpawnCapabilitySnapshot,\n    seen_activated_name: Arc<Mutex<Option<String>>>,\n}\n\nstruct BarrierModel {\n    barrier: Arc<tokio::sync::Barrier>,\n}\n\nstruct BlockingModel {\n    entered: Arc<tokio::sync::Notify>,\n    release: Arc<tokio::sync::Notify>,\n}\n\nimpl ModelProvider for BarrierModel {\n    fn respond<'a>(&'a self, _request: ModelRequest) -> ModelFuture<'a> {\n        let barrier = self.barrier.clone();\n        Box::pin(async move {\n            barrier.wait().await;\n            Ok(ModelResponse::text(\"parallel child complete\"))\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ModelProvider for BlockingModel {\n    fn respond<'a>(&'a self, _request: ModelRequest) -> ModelFuture<'a> {\n        let entered = self.entered.clone();\n        let release = self.release.clone();\n        Box::pin(async move {\n            entered.notify_one();\n            release.notified().await;\n            Ok(ModelResponse::text(\"late child complete\"))\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ChildRegistryFactory for EmptyChildRegistry {\n    fn build_registry(\n        &self,\n        _role: &str,\n        _input: &SpawnInput,\n        _suggestions: Option<&AgentSuggestions>,\n    ) -> Result<ExtensionRegistry, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(ExtensionRegistryBuilder::default().build())\n    }\n\n    fn model_for(&self, role: &str) -> Result<Arc<dyn ModelProvider>, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(Arc::new(EchoModelProvider::new(format!(\"{role} complete\"))))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ChildRegistryFactory for BarrierChildRegistry {\n    fn build_registry(\n        &self,\n        _role: }\n}\n\nimpl ChildRegistryFactory for BlockingChildRegistry {\n    fn build_registry(\n        &self,\n        _role: &str,\n        _input: &SpawnInput,\n        _suggestions: Option<&AgentSuggestions>,\n    ) -> Result<ExtensionRegistry, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(ExtensionRegistryBuilder::default().build())\n    }\n\n    fn model_for(&self, _role: &str) -> Result<Arc<dyn ModelProvider>, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(Arc::new(BlockingModel {\n            entered: self.entered.clone(),\n            release: self.release.clone(),\n        }))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ChildRegistryFactory for SnapshotChildRegistry {\n    fn build_registry(\n        &self,\n        _role: &str,\n        _input: &SpawnInput,\n        _suggestions: Option<&AgentSuggestions>,\n    ) -> Result<ExtensionRegistry, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(ExtensionRegistryBuilder::default().build())\n    }\n\n    fn capability_snapshot(\n        &self,\n        _role: &str,\n        _input: &SpawnInput,\n    ) -> Result<Option<SpawnCapabilitySnapshot>, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(Some(self.snapshot.clone()))\n    }\n\n    fn build_registry_with_capabilities(\n        &self,\n        _role: &str,\n        _input: &SpawnInput,\n        snapshot: Option<&SpawnCapabilitySnapshot>,\n    ) -> Result<ExtensionRegistry, AgentSpawnError> {\n        let activated = snapshot\n            .and_then(|snapshot| snapshot.activated.first())\n            .map(|capability| capability.name.clone());\n        *self.seen_activated_name.lock().expect(\"seen snapshot lock\") = activated;\n        Ok(ExtensionRegistryBuilder::default().build())\n    }\n\n    fn model_for(&self, role: &str) -> Result<Arc<dyn ModelProvider>, AgentSpawnError> {\n        Ok(Arc::new(EchoModelProvider::new(format!(\"{role} complete\"))))\n    }\n}\n\nfn test_sandbox(permissions: PermissionSet) -> SandboxSpec {\n    let harness_root = PathBuf::from(env!(\"CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR\"))\n        .parent()\n        .expect(\"harw-core has a workspace parent\")\n        .to_path_buf();\n    let registry = WorkspaceRegistry::build(\n        &harness_root,\n        [WorkspaceRegistration {\n            tenant: TenantId::from_str(\"test-tenant\"),\n            workspace: WorkspaceId::from_str(\"controller-tests\"),\n            root: PathBuf::from(\"harw-core\"),\n        }],\n    )\n    .expect(\"test workspace is registered\");\n    SandboxSpec::from_resolved(\n        registry\n            .resolve(\n                &TenantId::from_str(\"test-tenant\"),\n                &WorkspaceId::from_str(\"controller-tests\"),\n            )\n            .expect(\"tn        let status = match drained {\n            Err(_elapsed) => {\n                terminate(&mut child).await;\n                warn!(timeout_secs = effective_timeout, \"shell.exec timed out\");\n                return Ok(self.timeout_output(effective_timeout, &capture));\n            }\n            Ok(Err(err)) => {\n                terminate(&mut child).await;\n                warn!(error = %err, \"shell.exec output read failed\");\n                return Ok(ToolOutput::error(format!(\n                    \"shell.exec: process I/O error: {err}\"\n                )));\n            }\n            Ok(Ok(DrainEnd::LimitExceeded)) => {\n                // Niemand liest mehr: Prozessbaum sofort beenden statt bis zum Timeout\n                // weiterlaufen zu lassen (Pipe voll → Kind blockiert, CPU/Disk-Last bleibt).\n                let status = terminate(&mut child).await;\n                warn!(\n                    max_output_bytes = self.max_output_bytes,\n                    \"shell.exec output limit exceeded; process tree killed\"\n                );\n                return Ok(self.completed_output(status, &capture, true));\n            }\n            Ok(Ok(DrainEnd::Eof)) => {\n                match tokio::time::timeout_at(deadline, child.wait()).await {\n                    Ok(Ok(status)) => status,\n                    Ok(Err(err)) => {\n                        terminate(&mut child).await;\n                        warn!(error = %err, \"shell.exec wait failed\");\n                        return Ok(ToolOutput::error(format!(\n                            \"shell.exec: process I/O error: {err}\"\n                        )));\n                    }\n                    Err(_elapsed) => {\n                        terminate(&mut child).await;\n                        warn!(timeout_secs = effective_timeout, \"shell.exec timed out\");\n                        return Ok(self.timeout_output(effective_timeout, &capture));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        };\n\n        Ok(self.completed_output(Some(status), &capture, false))\n    }\n\n    /// Prüft die Limits und löst `prlimit` an den festen Pfaden auf.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// tmpfs-Größe für bwrap `--size` und den `prlimit`-Pfad (`None` nur, wenn\n    /// `require_rlimits == false` und `prlimit` fehlt).\n    fn resolve_limits(&self) -> Result<(NonZeroU64, Option<PathBuf>), ShellLimitsError> {\n        self.limits.validate()?;\n        let tmpfs_size = self.limits.tmpfs_size()?;\n        let prlimit = self.limits.resolve_prlimit()?;\n        Ok((tmpfs_size, prlimit))\n    }\n\n    /// JSON-Ergebnis eines beendeten (oder wegen Ausgabeüberlauf getöteten) Prozesses.\n    ///\n    /// `killed_by_output_limit` ist der Kürzungshinweis für den Aufrufer: Die Ausgabe ist\n    /// gekappt **und** das Kommando lief nicht zu Ende; `exit_code` ist dann `-1` (Signal).\n    fn completed_output(\n        &self,\n        status: Option<ExitStatus>,\n        capture: &BoundedCapture,\n        killed_by_output_limit: bool,\n    ) -> ToolOutput {\n        let exit_code = status.and_then(|status| status.code()).unwrap_or(-1);\n        let (stdout_str, stderr_str, truncated) = Self::truncate_combined_output(\n            capture.stdout(),\n            capture.stderr(),\n            self.max_output_bytes,\n        );\n        let truncated = truncated || killed_by_output_limit;\n\n        info!(exit_code, truncated, killed_by_output_limit, \"shell.exec completed\");\n\n        ToolOutput::json(json!({\n            \"exit_code\": exit_code,\n            \"stdout\": stdout_str,\n            \"stderr\": stderr_str,\n            \"truncated\": truncated,\n            \"killed_by_output_limit\": killed_by_output_limit,\n        }))\n    }\n\n    /// Fehlerergebnis bei Timeout, das die bis dahin gelesene Teilausgabe (im selben\n    /// Byte-Budget gekürzt) mitliefert.\n    fn timeout_output(&self, timeout_secs: u64, capture: &BoundedCapture) -> ToolOutput {\n        let (stdout, stderr, truncated) = Self::truncate_combined_output(\n            capture.stdout(),\n            capture.stderr(),\n            self.max_output_bytes,\n        );\n        ToolOutput::error(format!(\n            \"shell.exec timed out after {timeout_secs}s; process tree killed. \\\n             Partial output (truncated: {truncated}):\\n[stdout]\\n{stdout}\\n[stderr]\\n{stderr}\"\n        ))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Setzt die Standard-Streams für den Sandbox-Start: stdin `/dev/null` (nie das geerbte\n/// Terminal), stdout/stderr als Pipes, SIGKILL beim Drop des `Child`.\nfn configure_stdio(command: &mut TokioCommand) -> &mut TokioCommand {\n    command\n        .stdin(Stdio::null())\n        .stdout(Stdio::piped())\n        .stderr(Stdio::piped())\n        .kill_on_drop(true)\n}\n\n/// Beendet den direkten Kindprozess (`prlimit` hat sich per `exec` durch `bwrap` ersetzt)\n/// per SIGKILL und sammelt den Exit-Status ein. `bwrap --die-with-parent` und der\n/// PID-Namespace beenden daraufhin den gesamten Sandbox-Prozessbaum, auch per\n/// `setsid`/`nohup` abgekoppelte Nachfahren.\nasync fn terminate(child: &mut Child) -> Option<ExitStatus> {\n    if let Err(err) = child.start_kill() {\n        warn!(error = %err, \"shell.exec kill failed\");\n    }\n    match tokio::time::timeout(KILL_REAP_TIMEOUT, child.wait()).await {\n        Ok(Ok(status)) => Some(status),\n        Ok(Err(err)) => {\n            warn!(error = %err, \"shell.exec reap after kill failed\");\n            None\n        }\n        Err(_elapsed) => {\n            warn!(\"shell.exec reap after kill timed out; relying on kill_on_drop\");\n            None\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl ToolExecutor for ShellExecutor {\n    /// Executes the `shell.exec` tool call.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    /// 1. Parses `call.arguments` into [`ShellExecArgs`].\n    /// 2. Rejects blank commands and caller-provided zero timeouts.\n    /// 3. Checks that [`Permission::ExecuteProcess`] is granted in `context.sandbox()`.\n    /// 4. Builds a Bubblewrap plan from `context.sandbox()`.\n    /// 5. Executes `/bin/sh -c <command>` inside that plan with the effective timeout.\n    /// 6. Returns a JSON `ToolOutput` with `exit_code`, `stdout`, `stderr`, and `truncated`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    /// - `context` (`&ToolExecutionContext`): harness-established sandbox authority.\n    /// - `call` (`&ToolCall`): untrusted invocation; `arguments` must match [`ShellExecArgs`].\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    /// `Ok(ToolOutput::json(...))` on success, `Ok(ToolOutput::error(...))` on permission\n    /// denial or runtime failure, `Err(ToolsError::InvalidArguments)` if arguments cannot\n    /// be parsed.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    /// - [`ToolsError::InvalidArguments`]: arguments JSON does not conform to the tool schema.\n    ///\n    /// # Concurrency\n    /// `Send + Sync`. The returned future is `Send`.\n    ///\n    /// # Panics\n    /// None.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    /// ```rust,no_run\n    /// use harw_tool_shell::ShellToolProvider;\n    /// use harw_extension_api::contributors::ToolProvider;\n    /// use harw_tools::spec::ToolName;\n    ///\n    /// let provider = ShellToolProvider::new();\n    /// let executor = provider.executor(&ToolName::new(\"shell.exec\")).unwrap();\n    /// // executor.execute(&ctx, &call).await\n    /// ```\n    fn execute<'a>(\n        &'a self,\n        context: &'a ToolExecutionContext,\n        call: &'a ToolCall,\n    ) -> ToolExecutorFuture<'a> {\n        Box::pin(async move {\n            // 1. Parse arguments\n            let args: ShellExecArgs =\n                serde_json::from_value(call.arguments.clone()).map_err(|err| {\n                    ToolsError::InvalidArguments {\n                        name: TOOL_NAME.to_owned(),\n                        reason: err.to_string(),\n                    }\n                })?;\n\n            // 2. Reject invalid caller-controlled values before sandbox planning or spawn.\n            self.effective_timeout(&args)?;\n\n            // 3. Permission check\n            if let Some(err) = harw_tools::sandbox_guard::require_permission(\n                conte�─────────────\n\n/// The decided values applied to a position before BAPI assembly.\nstruct DecisionOverlay {\n    gl_account: String,\n    cost_center: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Reduce decisions to the latest one per `ITEMNO_ACC` (decisions carry `itemno_acc` as text).\n///\n/// Decisions whose `itemno_acc` is absent or non-numeric are ignored here — see\n/// [`latest_whole_invoice_decision`] for those. When several decisions target the\n/// same line, the one with the most recent `decided_at` wins.\nfn latest_decisions_by_itemno(decisions: &[DecisionRecord]) -> HashMap<i32, DecisionOverlay> {\n    let mut latest: HashMap<i32, (DateTime<Utc>, DecisionOverlay)> = HashMap::new();\n    for decision in decisions {\n        let Some(itemno) = decision\n            .itemno_acc\n            .as_deref()\n            .and_then(|s| s.trim().parse::<i32>().ok())\n        else {\n            continue;\n        };\n        let is_newer = match latest.get(&itemno) {\n            Some((existing_at, _)) => decision.decided_at >= *existing_at,\n            None => true,\n        };\n        if is_newer {\n            latest.insert(\n                itemno,\n                (\n                    decision.decided_at,\n                    DecisionOverlay {\n                        gl_account: decision.gl_account.clone(),\n                        cost_center: decision.cost_center.clone(),\n                    },\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n    }\n    latest\n        .into_iter()\n        .map(|(itemno, (_, overlay))| (itemno, overlay))\n        .collect()\n}\n\n/// Find the most recent \"whole invoice\" decision — one recorded with no\n/// `itemno_acc` (see `POST /accept` with an empty `items` array, the common path\n/// for single-line invoices or a blanket approval covering every GL line).\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// [`latest_decisions_by_itemno`] silently drops every decision lacking a numeric\n/// `itemno_acc`, which historically meant a whole-invoice \"approved\" decision\n/// never reached [`overlay_and_assemble`] — the assembled BAPI document fell back\n/// to the raw extraction skeleton's literal `\"Platzhalter\"` GL account even though\n/// a human/AI decision had genuinely approved a real account. This helper recovers\n/// that decision so it can be applied as the default for every `ACCOUNTGL` line\n/// that has no more specific per-item override.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// - `decisions` (`&[DecisionRecord]`): all decisions loaded for the invoice.\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// `Some(DecisionOverlay)` for the latest (`decided_at` DESC) decision with an\n/// absent/blank `itemno_acc`, or `None` when every decision is per-item.\nfn latest_whole_invoice_decision(decisions: &[DecisionRecord]) -> Option<DecisionOverlay> {\n    decisions\n        .iter()\n        .filter(|d| {\n            d.itemno_acc\n                .as_deref()\n                .map(|s| s.trim().is_empty())\n                .unwrap_or(true)\n        })\n        .max_by_key(|d| d.decided_at)\n        .map(|d| DecisionOverlay {\n            gl_account: d.gl_account.clone(),\n            cost_center: d.cost_center.clone(),\n        })\n}\n\n/// Overlay the approved decisions onto the positions and assemble a balanced BAPI document.\n///\n/// # Errors\n/// Propagates [`crate::bapi::error::BapiError`] from assembly / balance validation (e.g.\n/// a missing GL account or an unbalanced document).\nfn overlay_and_assemble(\n    assembled: &AssembledInvoice,\n    decisions: &[DecisionRecord],\n) -> BapiResult<BapiDocument> {\n    let overlays = latest_decisions_by_itemno(decisions);\n    // Fallback for the common \"whole invoice\" accept path (no per-item overrides\n    // submitted): applies to every ACCOUNTGL line lacking a more specific per-item\n    // decision, so the approved account replaces the raw extraction's placeholder\n    // instead of a per-item decision requirement silently never being met.\n    let whole_invoice_overlay = latest_whole_invoice_decision(decisions);\n    let mut positions = assembled.positions.clone();\n    for pos in &mut positions {\n        if let Some(overlay) = overlays.get(&pos.itemno_acc) {\n            pos.gl_account = Some(overlay.gl_account.clone());\n            if overlay.cost_center.is_some() {\n                pos.cost_center = overlay.cost_center.clone();\n            }\n        } else if pos.position_type == PositionType::Gl\n            && let Some(overlay) = &whole_invoice_overlay\n        {\n            pos.gl_account = Some(overlay.gl_account.clone());\n            if overlay.cost_center.is_some() {\n                pos.cost_center = overlay.cost_center.clone();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    if let Some(vat) =\n        synthesize_vat_position(&assembled.header, &positions, &assembled.raw_payload)\n    {\n        positions.push(vat);\n    }\n    let document = assemble(&assembled.header, &positions)?\n        .validate_balance()?\n        .into_document();\n    Ok(document)\n}\n\n/// Compute the unbalanced delta (debit - credit) over the given positions using the\n/// same sign convention as `bapi::builder::validate_balance`:\n/// positive `amt_doccur` = debit, negative = credit. Returns `debit - credit`.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Iterates all positions that carry `Some(amt_doccur)` and accumulates two buckets:\n/// non-negative values sum into `debit`, negative values sum their magnitude into `credit`.\n/// Returns `debit - credit`:\n/// - `> 0` → more debit than credit (document short a credit).\n/// - `< 0` → more credit than debit (document short a debit).\n/// - `== 0` → already balanced.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `positions` (`&[InvoicePosition]`): the current set of assembled positions. Positions\n///   with `amt_doccur == None` are skipped (they do not contribute to the balance).\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// [`Decimal`] — the signed delta `debit - credit`. Zero means balanced.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Pure function; no shared state. Safe to call from any thread.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// // net +100 debit, -100 credit → delta == 0 (balanced)\n/// // net +200 debit, -100 credit → delta == +100 (short a credit)\n/// ```\nfn position_balance_delta(positions: &[InvoicePosition]) -> Decimal {\n    let mut debit = Decimal::ZERO;\n    let mut credit = Decimal::ZERO;\n    for pos in positions {\n        if let Some(amt) = pos.amt_doccur {\n            if amt.is_sign_negative() {\n                credit -= amt; // subtract negative → add magnitude\n            } else {\n                debit += amt;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    debit - credit\n}\n\n/// Synthesize a single balancing VAT Tax position from the raw payload's\n/// `tax.breakdown`, but ONLY when (a) the assembled positions are unbalanced and\n/// (b) the magnitude of the imbalance equals the summed `tax_amount.value` of the\n/// breakdown (within zero tolerance). Injects a `PositionType::Tax` position whose\n/// `amt_doccur` is exactly the signed delta needed to reach balance (so debits ==\n/// credits). Returns `Some(position)` to inject, or `None` to leave positions as-is.\n/// Never fabricates an amount not present in `tax.breakdown`.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Guards against over-injection: returns `None` when the document is already balanced,\n/// when a `Tax` position already exists in `positions`, or when the breakdown VAT total\n/// does not exactly match the imbalance magnitude. The injected `amt_doccur` is `-delta`\n/// so that `position_balance_delta` yields zero after the push.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `header` (`&InvoiceHeader`): used for `invoice_id` and `id` on the synthesized row.\n/// - `positions` (`&[InvoicePosition]`): the current assembled positions (post-overlay).\n/// - `raw_payload` (`&JsonValue`): the raw extracted payload; VAT breakdown lives at\n///   `[\"tax\"][\"breakdown\"][i]` with `tax_amount.value` (STRING decimal), `tax_amount.currency`,\n///   `taxable_amount.value`, and `category_code`.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// `Some(InvoicePosition)` when synthesis is warranted; `None` otherwise.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Pure function (modulo `Uuid::new_v4()` and `Utc::now()`). Safe to call from any thread.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// // positions: GL +1009 debit + payable -1200.71 credit, breakdown tax_amount \"191.71\"\n/// // → returns Some with amt_doccur = 191.71 and position_type = Tax\n/// ```\nfn synthesize_vat_position(\n    header: &InvoiceHeader,\n    positions: &[InvoicePosition],\n    raw_payload: &JsonValue,\n) -> Option<InvoicePosition> {\n    let delta = position_balance_delta(positions);\n\n    // Already balanced — nothing to do.\n    if delta == Decimal::ZERO {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // A Tax position already exists — do not double-inject.\n    if positions\n        .iter()\n        .any(|p| p.position_type == PositionType::Tax)\n    {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Parse the tax breakdown array.\n    let breakdown = raw_payload[\"tax\"][\"breakdown\"].as_array()?;\n\n    // Sum all tax_amount.value fields (STRING decimals) in the breakdown.\n    // Skip any entry that doesn't parse cleanly.\n    let mut vat_total = Decimal::ZERO;\n    let mut parsed_any = false;\n    for entry in breakdown {\n        if let Some(val) = entry[\"tax_amount\"][\"value\"]\n            .as_str()\n            .and_then(|s| s.parse::<Decimal>().ok())\n        {\n            vat_total += val;\n            parsed_any = true;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // If nothing parsed, bail out.\n    if !parsed_any {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Only synthesize when the imbalance magnitude exactly equals the VAT total.\n    if vat_total.abs() != delta.abs() {\n        return None;\n    }\n\n    // Read supplementary fields from breakdown[0].\n    let bd0 = breakdown.first()?;\n    let tax_code = bd0[\"category_code\"].as_str().map(str::to_string);\n    let currency = bd0[\"tax_amount\"][\"currency\"].as_str().map(str::to_string);\n    let amt_base = bd0[\"taxable_amount\"][\"value\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse::<Decimal>().ok());\n\n    // itemno_acc = max existing + 10\n    let itemno_acc = positions.iter().map(|p| p.itemno_acc).max().unwrap_or(0) + 10;\n\n    let now = Utc::now();\n\n    Some(InvoicePosition {\n        id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n        invoice_id: header.id,\n        itemno_acc,\n        position_type: PositionType::Tax,\n        gl_account: None,\n        cost_center: None,\n        func_area: None,\n        profit_ctr: None,\n        wbs_element: None,\n        order_id: None,\n        segment: None,\n        tax_code,\n        unit_code: None,\n        quantity: None,\n        item_text: Some(\"VAT (synthesized to balance)\".to_string()),\n        itemno_tax: None,\n        vendor_no: None,\n        baseline_date: None,\n        payment_terms: None,\n        payment_block: None,\n        payment_method: None,\n        partner_bank: None,\n        alloc_number: None,\n        description: None,\n        curr_type: Some(\"00\".to_string()),\n        currency,\n        amt_doccur: Some(-delta),\n        amt_base,\n        created_at: now,\n        updated_at: now,\n    })\n}\n\n// ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}` — invoice header, payload, AI-coded items, and decisions.\nasync fn get_invoice_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let assembled = match load(&state, invoice_id, claims.organization_id).await {\n        Ok(a) => a,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    // Merge header fields with the full extracted payload (xmlinvoice schema)\n    let header_value = match serde_json::to_value(&assembled.header) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(_) => {\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to serialize invoice header\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n    let mut combined = serde_json::Map::new();\n    if let serde_json::Value::Object(header_map) = header_value {\n        combined.extend(header_map);\n    }\n    if let serde_json::Value::Object(payload_map) = assembled.raw_payload.clone() {\n        combined.extend(payload_map);\n    }\n\n    // Add AI-coded line items (with hypothesis_gl_account, confidence, etc.)\n    if let Ok(Some(items)) = state\n        .invoice_items\n        .list_for_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n    {\n        let items_json: Vec<serde_json::Value> = items\n            .iter()\n            .map(|r| {\n                serde_json::json!({\n                    \"invoice_item_id\": r.invoice_item_id,\n                    \"itemno_acc\": r.itemno_acc,\n                    \"gl_account\": r.gl_account,\n                    \"cost_center\": r.cost_center,\n                    \"tax_code\": r.tax_code,\n                    \"quantity\": r.quantity.as_ref().map(|q| q.to_string()),\n                    \"item_text\": r.item_text,\n                    \"final_account_name\": r.final_account_name,\n                    \"final_gl_account\": r.final_gl_account,\n                    \"hypothesis_account_name\": r.hypothesis_account_name,\n                    \"hypothesis_gl_account\": r.hypothesis_gl_account,\n                    \"confidence\": r.confidence.as_ref().map(|c| c.to_string()),\n                    \"explanation\": r.explanation,\n                    \"kontenart\": r.kontenart,\n                })\n            })\n            .collect();\n        combined.insert(\"ai_items\".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Array(items_json));\n    }\n\n    // Add recorded decisions (final cost_center, gl_account, tax_treatment)\n    if let Ok(decisions) = state\n        .decision_service\n        .get_decisions_by_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n        && let Ok(d_value) = serde_json::to_value(&decisions)\n    {\n        combined.insert(\"decisions\".to_string(), d_value);\n    }\n\n    json_response(StatusCode::OK, &serde_json::Value::Object(combined))\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/bapi` — the SAP posting document (approved coding).\nasync fn bapi_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let assembled = match load(&state, invoice_id, claims.organization_id).await {\n        Ok(a) => a,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let decisions = match state\n        .decision_service\n        .get_decisions_by_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n    {\n        Ok(d) => d,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"failed to load decisions for bapi\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to load decisions\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    // A BAPI document can only be assembled from APPROVED accounting decisions\n    // (`invoice_decisions`). The AI proposal alone (in `invoice_items`) is not a\n    // posting authority — a human must review and approve it first. With no\n    // decisions recorded the document is simply not postable yet, which is a\n    // normal workflow state, not a data error. Return a clear, typed \"pending\"\n    // response (409) instead of running assembly and surfacing a confusing\n    // balance/placeholder error. Callers should show the AI proposal\n    // (`GET …/proposal`) for review until a decision is approved.\n    if decisions.is_empty() {\n        return json_response(\n            StatusCode::CONFLICT,\n            &serde_json::json!({\n                \"status\": \"pending_human_decision\",\n                \"message\": \"BAPI-Dokument noch nicht verfügbar: Es liegt keine \\\n                            freigegebene Kontierungsentscheidung vor. Bitte den \\\n                            KI-Vorschlag prüfen und freigeben, bevor gebucht \\\n                            werden kann.\",\n                \"invoice_id\": invoice_id,\n            }),\n        );\n    }\n\n    match overlay_and_assemble(&assembled, &decisions) {\n        Ok(document) => match serde_json::to_value(&document) {\n            Ok(v) => json_response(StatusCode::OK, &v),\n            Err(_) => error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to serialize BAPI document\",\n            ),\n        },\n        // A document that cannot post (unbalanced, missing GL account, …) is a 422 with\n        // the exact reason, not a 500 — the caller must fix the data, not retry.\n        Err(bapi_err) => error_response(StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, &bapi_err.to_string()),\n    }\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/proposal` — the raw AI proposal payload, verbatim.\nasync fn proposal_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    match load(&state, invoice_id, claims.organization_id).await {\n        Ok(assembled) => json_response(StatusCode::OK, &assembled.raw_payload),\n        Err(resp) => resp,\n    }\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/decision` — the recorded accounting decisions.\nasync fn decision_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    match state\n        .decision_service\n        .get_decisions_by_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n    {\n        Ok(decisions) => match serde_json::to_value(&decisions) {\n            Ok(v) => json_response(StatusCode::OK, &v),\n            Err(_) => error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to serialize decisions\",\n            ),\n        },\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"failed to load decisions\");\n            error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to load decisions\",\n            )\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/validation` — the latest validation result.\nasync fn validation_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    // validation_sessions keys on a TEXT invoice id and carries an explicit organization_id;\n    // filter on both for tenant isolation. Columns: detected_syntax, detected_profile,\n    // validation_result, created_at.\n    type ValidationRow = (\n        Option<String>,\n        Option<String>,\n        Option<JsonValue>,\n        DateTime<Utc>,\n    );\n    let row: Option<ValidationRow> = match sqlx::query_as(\n        r#\"\n            SELECT detected_syntax, detected_profile, validation_result, created_at\n            FROM validation_sessions\n            WHERE invoice_id = $1 AND organization_id = $2\n            ORDER BY created_at DESC\n            LIMIT 1\n            \"#,\n    )\n    .bind(invoice_id.to_string())\n    .bind(claims.organization_id)\n    .fetch_optional(state.db_pool.inner())\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"failed to load validation session\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to load validation result\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n    match row {\n        Some((detected_syntax, detected_profile, validation_result, created_at)) => json_response(\n            StatusCode::OK,\n            &json!({\n                \"detected_syntax\": detected_syntax,\n                \"detected_profile\": detected_profile,\n                \"validation_result\": validation_result,\n                \"created_at\": created_at,\n            }),\n        ),\n        None => error_response(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, \"No validation result for invoice\"),\n    }\n}\n\n/// A single node on the invoice's stage route.\n#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]\nstruct TimelineEntry {\n    /// The stage label (e.g. `received`, `approved`, the current status).\n    stage: String,\n    /// When the stage was entered.\n    at: DateTime<Utc>,\n    /// Who caused it, when known.\n    by: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// `GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/timeline` — the chronological stage route.\n///\n/// There is no dedicated status-history table; the route is reconstructed from the\n/// available org-scoped timestamps: ingest/extraction, each recorded decision, and the\n/// current header status.\nasync fn timeline_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let (claims, invoice_id) = match authorize(&req, &state, &params) {\n        Ok(v) => v,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let assembled = match load(&state, invoice_id, claims.organization_id).await {\n        Ok(a) => a,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n    let decisions = match state\n        .decision_service\n        .get_decisions_by_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n    {\n        Ok(d) => d,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"failed to load decisions for timeline\");\n            return error_response(StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, \"Failed to load timeline\");\n        }\n    };\n\n    let header = &assembled.header;\n    let mut entries: Vec<TimelineEntry> = Vec::new();\n    entries.push(TimelineEntry {\n        stage: \"received\".to_string(),\n        at: header.imported_at.unwrap_or(header.created_at),\n        by: None,\n    });\n    for decision in &decisions {\n        entries.push(TimelineEntry {\n            stage: decision.decision_type.clone(),\n            at: decision.decided_at,\n            by: Some(decision.decided_by.clone()),\n        });\n    }\n    entries.push(TimelineEntry {\n        stage: format!(\"{:?}\", header.status).to_lowercase(),\n        at: header.updated_at,\n        by: None,\n    });\n    entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.at);\n\n    match serde_json::to_value(&entries) {\n        Ok(v) => json_response(StatusCode::OK, &v),\n        Err(_) => error_response(\n            StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n            \"Failed to serialize timeline\",\n        ),\n    }\n}\n\n// ── Route wrappers + registration ───────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nhandler!(get_invoice_handler, get_invoice_impl);\nhandler!(bapi_handler, bapi_impl);\nhandler!(validation_handler, validation_impl);\nhandler!(proposal_handler, proposal_impl);\nhandler!(decision_handler, decision_impl);\nhandler!(timeline_handler, timeline_impl);\n\n/// Register the invoice output endpoints into the platform router.\n///\n/// # Errors\n/// [`crate::error::AppError::InvalidConfig`] if any route pattern is a duplicate.\npub fn register_routes(router: &mut matchit::Router<HandlerFn>) -> AppResult<()> {\n    insert_route(\n        router,\n        \"GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}\",\n        get_invoice_handler,\n    )?;\n    insert_route(\n        router,\n        \"GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/bapi\",\n        bapi_handler,\n    )?;\n    insert_route(\n        router,\n        \"GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/validation\",\n        validation_handler,\n    )?;\n    insert_route(\n        router,\n        \"GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/proposal\",\n        proposal_handler,\n    )?;\n    insert_route(\n        router,\n        \"GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/decision\",\n        decision_handler,\n    )?;\n    insert_route(\n        router,\n        \"GET /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/timeline\",\n        timeline_handler,\n    )?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use chrono::TimeZone;\n\n    fn dec(itemno: &str, gl: &str, cc: Option<&str>, offset_secs: i64) -> DecisionRecord {\n        DecisionRecord {\n            id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n            document_id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n            proposal_id: None,\n            decided_at: Utc.timestamp_opt(1_700_000_000 + offset_secs, 0).unwrap(),\n            decided_by: \"user@example.com\".to_string(),\n            decision_type: \"approved\".to_string(),\n            gl_account: gl.to_string(),\n            cost_center: cc.map(str::to_string),\n            tax_treatment: None,\n            override_reason: None,\n            notes: None,\n            invoice_item_id: None,\n            final_account_name: None,\n            itemno_acc: Some(itemno.to_string()),\n            organization_id: Uuid::new_v4(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn latest_decision_wins_per_itemno() {\n        let decisions = vec![\n            dec(\"10\", \"4000\", Some(\"CC1\"), 0),\n            dec(\"10\", \"4100\", Some(\"CC2\"), 100), // newer for line 10\n            dec(\"20\", \"6000\", None, 50),\n        ];\n        let map = latest_decisions_by_itemno(&decisions);\n        assert_eq!(map.len(), 2);\n        let line10 = map.get(&10).expect(\"line 10 present\");\n        assert_eq!(line10.gl_account, \"4100\");\n        assert_eq!(line10.cost_center.as_deref(), Some(\"CC2\"));\n        assert_eq!(map.get(&20).expect(\"line 20 present\").gl_account, \"6000\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn Gelesen\n# von `sgh-flow participant scaffold` (rendert Unit + Env) und künftig von\n# `make participant-provision NAME=sgh-acct` (legt Fehlendes bei vectory /\n# s3ice / secureHUB an).\n#\n# HARTE REGEL: hier steht NIE eine UUID oder ID. Deklariert werden nur Namen,\n# Arten und Grössen. Identitäten entstehen entweder deterministisch abgeleitet\n# (UUIDv5, siehe apps/sgh-flow/src/platform/system_principal_id.rs) oder werden\n# nach dem Provisionieren aus der Antwort zurückgelesen und vom Werkzeug in die\n# Env-Datei geschrieben. Der Manifest-Parser weist UUID-förmige Werte aktiv ab\n# (crates/sgh-participant/src/infra.rs::reject_if_uuid_like).\n#\n# Grund: am 2026-07-29 hat genau dieser Handabtipp einen Produktionsausfall\n# verursacht — abgetippte *_SYSTEM_PRINCIPAL_ID-Werte drifteten auseinander und\n# secureHUB antwortete mit einem nackten 403, das nichts benannte.\n\nname = \"sgh-acct\"\nport = 4610\nsubject_kinds = [\"invoice\"]\nsecret_var = \"PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET\"\n# SGH_ACCT_PLATFORM_TOKEN (Slice W7-5, nicht hier deklariert — kein\n# manifest-getriebenes Feld dafuer): API-Key, den\n# sgh-acct-service::platform_client::PlatformClient als Authorization: Bearer\n# gegen die Plattform sendet (Scopes invoices:read/write/approve). Erzeugt\n# von `sgh-flow acct ensure-platform-token`, landet in derselben\n# Laufzeit-Env wie secret_var oben. Siehe .env.example (Root) und\n# apps/sgh-flow/src/cli/ensure_acct_platform_token.rs.\n\n[extensions]\n# Tier-1-Entscheidung (Nutzer, 2026-08-17): voller Schnitt der Rechnungsdomäne\n# ueber den Participant sgh-acct — der oeffentliche Pfad heisst /invoice, nicht\n# /acct (FANOUT-CONTRACT-MASTER.md §3). /invoice ist segmentsicher: strip_prefix\n# verlangt \"/\" nach dem Praefix (crates/sgh-proxy/src/lib.rs:387-394), die\n# SPA-Route /invoices bleibt unberuehrt.\nROUTE_PREFIX = \"/invoice\"\nMCP_NAMESPACE = \"acct\"\nHEALTH_PATH = \"/health\"\n\n# ── Agent (KI-Rechnungskontierung) ───────────────────────────────────────────\n# module_path = \"python_agent\" ist relativ zum sgh-acct-Verzeichnis\n# (= sgh-acct/python_agent) — seit Commit b711b2d (2026-08-18) der einzige\n# Agentenbaum; der frühere Plattform-Baum mit smart_accounter.py existiert\n# dort nicht mehr. `make stage-agent` installiert diesen Baum nach\n# <prefix>/etc/sgh-flow/python_agent, wo ihn `SMART_AGENT_MODULE_PATH`\n# (Rust-Default data_dir(\"python_agent\")) findet. module: ermittelt aus dem\n# tatsächlich laufenden Env-File (/usr/local/etc/sgh-flow/sgh-flow.env), nicht\n# aus dem Contract-Beispiel. SMART_AGENT_MODULE ist dort NICHT gesetzt →\n# Default aus config.rs greift: \"smart_accounter\" (hat ein main()).\n# run_v2.py/agent.runner_v2 (V2-Orchestrator) existiert bereits im Baum, ist\n# aber noch nicht der scharf geschaltete Pfad — SMART_AGENT_MODULE wird\n# nirgends auf \"run_v2\" gesetzt. max_workers = 5, venv-Basisname aus\n# SMART_AGENT_VENV=/srv/dev-shared/projects/rust/sgh-flow/sgh-flow-venv.\n# AZURE_*/SMART_*/SGH_*-Env wird vom Supervisor per Präfixfilter an den\n# Agenten durchgereicht.\n[agent]\nmodule_path = \"python_agent\"\nmodule = \"smart_accounter\"\nvenv = \"sgh-flow-venv\"\nargv = []\nmax_workers = 5\n\n# ── Infrastruktur ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n# Eigener Vault: sgh-acct hält Fachdaten (acctdb) und braucht eigenes\n# Schlüsselmaterial, nicht das geteilte System-Vault der drei Kern-Participants.\n[infrastructure.secrets]\nvault = \"own\"\n\n# Die Stores, die heute in api/admin_vector_store.rs als DEFAULT_STORE_KINDS\n# hartkodiert sind. Diese Datei führt deshalb alle\n# sieben — genau dafür gibt es die eine Quelle. Solange resolve_store_kinds()\n# noch mit None aufgerufen wird, ändert das am Laufzeitverhalten nichts.\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"sachkonto\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:sachkonto\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"kreditor\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:kreditor\"\n\n# Nur im Python-Builder geführt, in DEFAULT_STORE_KINDS bisher fehlend.\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"positions\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:invoice_item\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"cost_center\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:cost_center\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"segment\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:segment\"\n\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"department\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"acctdb:department\"\n\n# Der decision-Store speist sich aus der Plattform-Wahrheit (Tabelle\n# `decisions`), nicht aus acctdb — sgh-acct liest sie über\n# GET /api/v1/decisions/{subject_kind}/{subject_id}.\n[[infrastructure.vector_stores]]\nkind = \"decision\"\nembedding_model = \"multilingual-e5-large\"\ndimension = 1024\nsource = \"platform:decisions?subject_kind=invoice\"\n\n# ── Iceberg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n# Entspricht den Tabellen, die der (bis Etappe 6 in apps/sgh-flow liegende)\n# alte Iceberg-Pfad heute hart verdrahtet hat. Deklarativ, damit der Bedarf\n# sichtbar ist; der Zugriffscode wandert in Etappe 6 nach sgh-acct.\n[[infrastructure.iceberg]]\nnamespace = \"acct\"\ntable = \"invoice_headers\"\nschema_ref = \"sgh-acct/schemas/invoice_headers.json\"\n\n[[infrastructure.iceberg]]\nnamespace = \"acct\"\ntable = \"invoice_lines\"\nschema_ref = \"sgh-acct/schemas/invoice_lines.json\"\n"},"duration_ms":1,"trust":"untrusted"}}

Lesender HTTP-Client gegen `sgh-acctd` fuer KI-Monitor, Dashboard und Analytics.\n//!\n//! ## Warum es diesen Client gibt\n//!\n//! Nach dem Schnitt der Rechnungsdomaene (`sgh-acct/CONTRACT.md`) liegen\n//! `ai_progress_event`, `task`, `invoice_ingest`, `invoice_item`,\n//! `invoice_line_classifications` und `invoice_qa_findings` in `acctdb`,\n//! waehrend KI-Monitor, Dashboard und Analytics bei `sgh-flow` bleiben\n//! (`sgh-acct/NACHWEIS.md` §4.1). Ein SQL-Join ueber zwei Datenbanken ist\n//! nicht darstellbar — die acct-Anteile kommen deshalb ueber HTTP, die\n//! Plattformanteile (`invoice_decisions`, `audit_log`, `users`, `orgs`,\n//! `notifications`) bleiben lokale SQL-Abfragen, und das Zusammenfuehren\n//! passiert im Rust-Code der jeweiligen Route.\n//!\n//! ## Verantwortung\n//!\n//! Besitzt vier lesende Aufrufe:\n//!\n//! 1. `GET {base}/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/events?since&invoice_id&limit`\n//!    (normativ `sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md`)\n//! 2. `GET {base}/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/tasks?status&limit`\n//!    (normativ `sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md`)\n//! 3. `GET {base}/api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary?from&to`\n//!    (normativ `sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md`)\n//! 4. `POST {base}/mcp` — generischer JSON-RPC-2.0-`tools/call`-Aufruf\n//!    ([`AcctClient::call_tool`]) fuer die drei Dashboard-Vertragswerkzeuge\n//!    `get_ai_monitor { window_minutes }`,\n//!    `get_ai_metrics_timeseries { from, to, bucket }` und\n//!    `list_ai_jobs { status?, limit? }`. Anders als die drei obigen Aufrufe\n//!    liefert dieser Pfad bereits die vollstaendige, von den Aufrufern\n//!    unveraendert durchgereichte Antwortform der jeweiligen Dashboard-Route\n//!    (`sgh-flow/src/api/admin_ai_monitor.rs`, `ai_metrics.rs`, `ai_jobs.rs`);\n//!    die drei aelteren Aufrufe bleiben als lokaler Notpfad bestehen, falls\n//!    `sgh-acctd` den `/mcp`-Aufruf nicht bedienen kann.\n//!\n//! Besitzt **nicht**: Schreibpfade nach `acctdb`, Entscheidungs- oder\n//! Auditwahrheit (bleibt Plattform), Vector-Store (bleibt vectory), und keine\n//! Iceberg-Oberflaeche (bleibt s3ice).\n//!\n//! ## Basis-URL\n//!\n//! Die Basis stammt aus der generischen Participant-Registry\n//! ([`crate::platform::registry::ParticipantRegistry`]), Eintrag `sgh-acct`,\n//! Feld `address` — also aus `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_ADDRESS` bzw.\n//! `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_PORT` (`apps/sgh-flow/src/config.rs`). Es wird\n//! bewusst **kein** neuer Konfigurationsschluessel eingefuehrt: der Client\n//! spricht denselben Participant an, den der Edge-Proxy unter `/acct`\n//! vorhaelt, nur direkt statt ueber den eigenen Proxy.\n//!\n//! ## Authentisierung\n//!\n//! Die drei aelteren REST-Aufrufe ([`AcctClient::monitor_events`],\n//! [`AcctClient::monitor_tasks`], [`AcctClient::analytics_summary`]) tragen\n//! zwei Nachweise, beide aus dem geteilten Geheimnis\n//! `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET`:\n//!\n//! - ein kurzlebiges, organisationsgebundenes HS256-Bearer-Token (identisch\n//!   zum Muster in [`crate::api::dashboard`]),\n//! - die signierten `X-SGH-*`-Edge-Kopfzeilen (`Org-Id`, `Subject-Id`,\n//!   `Edge-Timestamp-Ms`, `Edge-Signature`) mit derselben Signaturformel wie\n//!   der Plattform-Proxy (`apps/sgh-flow/src/platform/inbound.rs`,\n//!   `participant_edge_signature_header`).\n//!\n//! [`AcctClient::call_tool`] (der `/mcp`-Pfad) traegt zwei ANDERE, vom\n//! Kontrakt vorgegebene Nachweise:\n//!\n//! - `Authorization: Bearer $SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN` — dasselbe statische,\n//!   geteilte Dienst-Token, das `sgh-acctd` bereits fuer sein `/mcp`\n//!   akzeptiert (siehe `apps/sgh-flow/src/services/acct_shadow.rs`,\n//!   `apps/sgh-flow/src/cli/acct.rs`). Kein pro-Aufruf gemintetes JWT.\n//! - dieselben signierten `X-SGH-*`-Edge-Kopfzeilen wie oben, ueber\n//!   `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET` signiert — sie tragen die\n//!   verifizierte `organization_id` des aufrufenden Admin-Claims, denn das\n//!   statische Bearer-Token allein enthaelt keine Mandanteninformation.\n//!\n//! ## Fehler\n//!\n//! Alle Fehler dieses Moduls sind [`AcctClientError`]; [`Result`] ist der\n//! zugehoerige Alias.\n//!\n//! ## Nebenlaeufigkeit\n//!\n//! [`AcctClient`] kapselt einen `reqwest::Client` (intern verbindungsgepoolt)\n//! und ist `Clone + Send + Sync`; gefahrlos ueber `Arc` teilbar.\n//!\n//! ## Examples\n//!\n//! ```rust,no_run\n//! use sgh_flow::services::acct_client::{AcctClient, MonitorEventsQuery};\n//! use uuid::Uuid;\n//!\n//! # async fn example(base: &str) -> sgh_flow::services::acct_client::Result<()> {\n//! let client = AcctClient::new(base)?;\n//! let org = Uuid::new_v4();\n//! let events = client\n//!     .monitor_events(org, &MonitorEventsQuery { limit: Some(30), ..Default::default() })\n//!     .await?;\n//! let _ = events.len();\n//! # Ok(())\n//! # }\n//! ```\n\nuse std::fmt;\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse chrono::Utc;\nuse hmac::{Hmac, Mac};\nuse jsonwebtoken::{Algorithm, EncodingKey, Header};\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse serde_json::{Value, json};\nuse sha2::Sha256;\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse crate::app::AppContext;\n\n// ─── Konstanten ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Participant-Kennung, unter der `sgh-acct` registriert ist.\npub const SGH_ACCT_PARTICIPANT_ID: &str = \"sgh-acct\";\n\n/// Umgebungsvariable mit dem geteilten Geheimnis zwischen sgh-flow und sgh-acctd.\nconst ACCT_SECRET_VAR: &str = \"PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET\";\n\n/// Umgebungsvariable mit dem statischen Dienst-Bearer-Token fuer `sgh-acctd`s\n/// `/mcp`-Endpunkt (dasselbe Token, das `acct_shadow.rs` und `cli/acct.rs`\n/// bereits verwenden — kein pro-Aufruf gemintetes JWT).\nconst ACCT_BEARER_TOKEN_VAR: &str = \"SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN\";\n\n/// Gesamtzeitlimit eines einzelnen Aufrufs.\n///\n/// Bewusst knapp: der KI-Monitor wird im Sekundentakt gepollt: ein haengender\n/// acct-Aufruf duerfte die Oberflaeche nicht blockieren, sondern muss zuegig\n/// in den Teilausfall laufen.\nconst REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(5);\n\n/// Lebensdauer eines ausgestellten Lese-Tokens in Sekunden.\nconst TOKEN_TTL_SECS: i64 = 300;\n\n/// Fester Dienst-Principal fuer Aufrufe von sgh-flow an sgh-acct.\n///\n/// Eigene Konstante statt Wiederverwendung des Dashboard-Subjekts, damit ein\n/// abgefangenes Token nicht auf einem anderen Pfad wiedergespielt werden kann.\n///\n/// `pub(crate)`, weil auch der Shadow-Ingest-Haken\n/// ([`crate::services::acct_shadow`]) seinen Edge-Kontext mit **diesem**\n/// Subjekt signiert: eine zweite Konstante waere eine zweite erfundene\n/// Identitaet fuer denselben Dienst-zu-Dienst-Weg.\npub(crate) const ACCT_READ_SERVICE_SUBJECT: Uuid =\n    Uuid::from_u128(0x7c11_9d3a_51b4_4f27_8e6a_0b3c_5d7e_9f10);\n\n/// Fester `api_key_id`-Claim der ausgestellten Lese-Tokens.\nconst ACCT_READ_API_KEY_ID: Uuid = Uuid::from_u128(0x7c11_9d3a_51b4_4f27_8e6a_1122_3344_5566);\n\n// ─── Fehlertyp ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Fehler dieses Clients.\n///\n/// Jede Variante traegt genug Zusammenhang, um den Ausfall ohne Quelltext zu\n/// verstehen — Aufrufer stufen daraus ihren Teilausfall ein.\npub enum AcctClientError {\n    /// Der Participant `sgh-acct` ist nicht registriert oder abgeschaltet.\n    ParticipantUnavailable(String),\n    /// Die Participant-Registry konnte nicht gelesen werden.\n    Registry(crate::error::AppError),\n    /// Das geteilte Geheimnis fehlt oder ist leer.\n    SecretMissing {\n        /// Name der erwarteten Umgebungsvariablen.\n        variable: String,\n    },\n    /// Das Lese-Token liess sich nicht signieren.\n    TokenMint(String),\n    /// Verbindungs-, TLS- oder Zeitueberschreitungsfehler.\n    Transport(reqwest::Error),\n    /// `sgh-acctd` hat mit einem Nicht-2xx-Status geantwortet.\n    HttpStatus {\n        /// HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort.\n        status: u16,\n        /// Angeforderter Pfad, ohne Basis-URL.\n        path: String,\n        /// Antwortkoerper, auf 512 Zeichen gekuerzt.\n        body: String,\n    },\n    /// Die Antwort war kein gueltiges JSON der erwarteten Form.\n    Decode {\n        /// Angeforderter Pfad, ohne Basis-URL.\n        path: String,\n        /// Meldung des Deserialisierers.\n        reason: String,\n    },\n    /// Die Basis-URL des Participants ist leer oder unbrauchbar.\n    InvalidBaseUrl(String),\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Display for AcctClientError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Self::ParticipantUnavailable(detail) => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acct participant is unavailable: {detail}\")\n            }\n            Self::Registry(error) => {\n                write!(f, \"participant registry lookup failed: {error}\")\n            }\n            Self::SecretMissing { variable } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"shared secret {variable} is unset or empty; cannot authenticate to sgh-acctd\"\n            ),\n            Self::TokenMint(reason) => {\n                write!(f, \"could not mint an sgh-acct read token: {reason}\")\n            }\n            Self::Transport(error) => write!(f, \"sgh-acctd request failed: {error}\"),\n            Self::HttpStatus { status, path, body } => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acctd answered HTTP {status} for {path}: {body}\")\n            }\n            Self::Decode { path, reason } => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acctd response for {path} did not decode: {reason}\")\n            }\n            Self::InvalidBaseUrl(detail) => {\n                write!(f, \"sgh-acct base URL is unusable: {detail}\")\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Debug delegiert bewusst an Display: eine Formulierung, keine zweite Wahrheit.\nimpl fmt::Debug for AcctClientError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        fmt::Display::fmt(self, f)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for AcctClientError {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        match self {\n            Self::Transport(error) => Some(error),\n            Self::Registry(error) => Some(error),\n            Self::ParticipantUnavailable(_)\n            | Self::SecretMissing { .. }\n            | Self::TokenMint(_)\n            | Self::HttpStatus { .. }\n            | Self::Decode { .. }\n            | Self::InvalidBaseUrl(_) => None,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl From<reqwest::Error> for AcctClientError {\n    fn from(error: reqwest::Error) -> Self {\n        Self::Transport(error)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl From<crate::error::AppError> for AcctClientError {\n    fn from(error: crate::error::AppError) -> Self {\n        Self::Registry(error)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Ergebnisalias dieses Moduls.\npub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, AcctClientError>;\n\n// ─── Wire-Typen (sgh-acct/ANALYTICS-API.md) ───────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Ein Fortschrittsereignis aus `acctdb.ai_progress_event`, angereichert um die\n/// Ingest-Angaben (`invoice_ingest`), die auf acct-Seite gejoint werden.\n///\n/// Alle Felder ausser `id`/`invoice_id` sind optional: die Gegenseite darf\n/// Felder nachliefern, ohne dass diese Seite bricht (defensive Kodierung, wie\n/// im Auftrag verlangt).\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, Deserialize, Serialize)]\npub struct AcctProgressEvent {\n    /// Ereignis-Kennung auf acct-Seite.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub id: Option<Uuid>,\n    /// Rechnung, zu der das Ereignis gehoert.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub invoice_id: Option<Uuid>,\n    /// Pipeline-Stufe, z. B. `segmentation`.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub stage: Option<String>,\n    /// Zustand der Stufe: `running` | `complete` | `failed`.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub status: Option<String>,\n    /// Freitextmeldung der Stufe.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub message: Option<String>,\n    /// Entstehungszeitpunkt.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub created_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    /// Urspruenglicher Dateiname aus `invoice_ingest`.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub ingest_filename: Option<String>,\n    /// Herkunft des Ingests (z. B. `upload`, `mail`).\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub ingest_source: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Ein Warteschlangeneintrag aus `acctdb.task`.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default, Deserialize, Serialize)]\npub struct AcctTask {\n    /// Task-Kennung.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub id: Option<Uuid>,\n    /// Zugehoeriger Job.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub job_id: Option<Uuid>,\n    /// Rechnung, auf die der Task wirkt.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub invoice_id: Option<Uuid>,\n    /// Zustand: `queued` | `running` | `done` | `failed`.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub status: Option<String>,\n    /// Anzahl bisheriger Versuche.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub attempt: Option<i64>,\n    /// Einstellzeitpunkt.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub created_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    /// Letzte Aenderung.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub updated_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    /// Ablauf der Bearbeitungsreservierung.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub lease_expires_at: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n}\n\n/// Aggregat aus `GET /api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary`.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default, Deserialize, Serialize)]\npub struct AcctAnalyticsSummary {\n    /// Rechnungen im Zeitraum.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub invoice_count: i64,\n    /// Rechnungspositionen im Zeitraum.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub item_count: i64,\n    /// Klassifizierte Positionszeilen.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub classified_line_count: i64,\n    /// QA-Befunde.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub qa_finding_count: i64,\n    /// Rechnungen mit terminalem Fortschrittsereignis.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub progress_terminal_count: i64,\n    /// Rechnungen mit laufendem Fortschrittsereignis.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub progress_running_count: i64,\n}\n\n/// Antworthuelle von Endpunkt 1.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Deserialize)]\nstruct MonitorEventsEnvelope {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    events: Vec<AcctProgressEvent>,\n}\n\n/// Antworthuelle von Endpunkt 2.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Deserialize)]\nstruct MonitorTasksEnvelope {\n    #[serde(default)]\n    tasks: Vec<AcctTask>,\n}\n\n// ─── Abfrageparameter ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Filter fuer `GET /api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/events`.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]\npub struct MonitorEventsQuery {\n    /// Nur Ereignisse ab diesem Zeitpunkt (RFC 3339 auf der Leitung).\n    pub since: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    /// Nur Ereignisse zu dieser Rechnung.\n    pub invoice_id: Option<Uuid>,\n    /// Obergrenze der zurueckgegebenen Ereignisse.\n    pub limit: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// Filter fuer `GET /api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/tasks`.\n#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]\npub struct MonitorTasksQuery {\n    /// Nur Tasks in diesem Zustand, z. B. `queued`.\n    pub status: Option<String>,\n    /// Obergrenze der zurueckgegebenen Tasks.\n    pub limit: Option<u32>,\n}\n\n/// Zeitraum fuer `GET /api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary`.\n#[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Default)]\npub struct AnalyticsSummaryQuery {\n    /// Beginn des Zeitraums, einschliesslich.\n    pub from: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n    /// Ende des Zeitraums, ausschliesslich.\n    pub to: Option<chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>>,\n}\n\n// ─── Client ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// Schlanker Lese-Client gegen `sgh-acctd`.\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct AcctClient {\n    http: reqwest::Client,\n    base_url: String,\n}\n\nimpl fmt::Debug for AcctClient {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {\n        f.debug_struct(\"AcctClient\")\n            .field(\"base_url\", &self.base_url)\n            .finish()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl AcctClient {\n    /// Erzeugt einen Client gegen eine bereits bekannte Basis-URL.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `base_url` (`&str`): Ursprung von `sgh-acctd`, z. B.\n    ///   `http://127.0.0.1:18183`. Ein abschliessender Schraegstrich wird\n    ///   entfernt.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(AcctClient)` mit einem verbindungsgepoolten `reqwest::Client`.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::InvalidBaseUrl`] — `base_url` ist leer.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — der HTTP-Client liess sich nicht bauen.\n    pub fn new(base_url: &str) -> Result<Self> {\n        let trimmed = base_url.trim().trim_end_matches('/');\n        if trimmed.is_empty() {\n            return Err(AcctClientError::InvalidBaseUrl(\n                \"empty address; set PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_ADDRESS or PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_PORT\"\n                    .to_owned(),\n            ));\n        }\n        let http = reqwest::Client::builder()\n            .timeout(REQUEST_TIMEOUT)\n            .build()?;\n        Ok(Self {\n            http,\n            base_url: trimmed.to_owned(),\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// Erzeugt einen Client aus der Participant-Registry des Anwendungszustands.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Kein eigener Konfigurationsschluessel: die Adresse kommt aus dem\n    /// generischen Participant-Eintrag `sgh-acct`, genau wie beim Edge-Proxy.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `state` (`&Arc<AppContext>`): liefert `participant_registry`.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(AcctClient)` wenn der Participant registriert und aktiv ist.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Registry`] — die Registry war nicht lesbar.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::ParticipantUnavailable`] — kein aktiver Eintrag `sgh-acct`.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::InvalidBaseUrl`] — der Eintrag hat keine Adresse.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — der HTTP-Client liess sich nicht bauen.\n    pub async fn from_state(state: &Arc<AppContext>) -> Result<Self> {\n        let participant = state\n            .participant_registry\n            .get(SGH_ACCT_PARTICIPANT_ID)\n            .await?\n            .filter(|participant| participant.enabled)\n            .ok_or_else(|| {\n                AcctClientError::ParticipantUnavailable(format!(\n                    \"participant '{SGH_ACCT_PARTICIPANT_ID}' is not registered or not enabled\"\n                ))\n            })?;\n        Self::new(&participant.address)\n    }\n\n    /// Holt Fortschrittsereignisse aus `acctdb`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant, an den Token und Edge-Kopfzeilen\n    ///   gebunden werden.\n    /// - `query` (`&MonitorEventsQuery`): optionale Filter.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(Vec<AcctProgressEvent>)`, moeglicherweise leer.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::SecretMissing`] / [`AcctClientError::TokenMint`] —\n    ///   Authentisierung nicht moeglich.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — sgh-acctd nicht erreichbar.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::HttpStatus`] — Nicht-2xx-Antwort.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Decode`] — Antwort passt nicht auf die Wire-Form.\n    pub async fn monitor_events(\n        &self,\n        organization_id: Uuid,\n        query: &MonitorEventsQuery,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<AcctProgressEvent>> {\n        let mut pairs: Vec<(&str, String)> = Vec::new();\n        if let Some(since) = query.since {\n            pairs.push((\"since\", since.to_rfc3339()));\n        }\n        if let Some(invoice_id) = query.invoice_id {\n            pairs.push((\"invoice_id\", invoice_id.to_string()));\n        }\n        if let Some(limit) = query.limit {\n            pairs.push((\"limit\", limit.to_string()));\n        }\n        let path = with_query(\"/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/events\", &pairs);\n        let envelope: MonitorEventsEnvelope = self.get_json(organization_id, &path).await?;\n        Ok(envelope.events)\n    }\n\n    /// Holt Warteschlangeneintraege aus `acctdb.task`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant.\n    /// - `query` (`&MonitorTasksQuery`): optionale Filter.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(Vec<AcctTask>)`, moeglicherweise leer.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// Wie [`AcctClient::monitor_events`].\n    pub async fn monitor_tasks(\n        &self,\n        organization_id: Uuid,\n        query: &MonitorTasksQuery,\n    ) -> Result<Vec<AcctTask>> {\n        let mut pairs: Vec<(&str, String)> = Vec::new();\n        if let Some(status) = query.status.as_deref() {\n            pairs.push((\"status\", status.to_owned()));\n        }\n        if let Some(limit) = query.limit {\n            pairs.push((\"limit\", limit.to_string()));\n        }\n        let path = with_query(\"/api/v1/admin/ai/monitor/tasks\", &pairs);\n        let envelope: MonitorTasksEnvelope = self.get_json(organization_id, &path).await?;\n        Ok(envelope.tasks)\n    }\n\n    /// Holt das Analytics-Aggregat aus `acctdb`.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant.\n    /// - `query` (`&AnalyticsSummaryQuery`): Zeitraum, beide Grenzen optional.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(AcctAnalyticsSummary)` — fehlende Felder zaehlen als 0.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// Wie [`AcctClient::monitor_events`].\n    pub async fn analytics_summary(\n        &self,\n        organization_id: Uuid,\n        query: &AnalyticsSummaryQuery,\n    ) -> Result<AcctAnalyticsSummary> {\n        let mut pairs: Vec<(&str, String)> = Vec::new();\n        if let Some(from) = query.from {\n            pairs.push((\"from\", from.to_rfc3339()));\n        }\n        if let Some(to) = query.to {\n            pairs.push((\"to\", to.to_rfc3339()));\n        }\n        let path = with_query(\"/api/v1/admin/ai/analytics/summary\", &pairs);\n        self.get_json(organization_id, &path).await\n    }\n\n    /// Ruft ein MCP-Werkzeug von `sgh-acctd` per JSON-RPC-2.0 `tools/call` auf.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Fuer die drei Dashboard-Vertragswerkzeuge `get_ai_monitor`,\n    /// `get_ai_metrics_timeseries` und `list_ai_jobs` — normativ in\n    /// `sgh-acct/CONTRACT.md` als Gegenstueck zu den drei\n    /// sgh-flow-Handlern `admin_ai_monitor.rs`, `ai_metrics.rs`, `ai_jobs.rs`\n    /// beschrieben. Anders als [`AcctClient::monitor_events`] und\n    /// Geschwister liefert `sgh-acctd` hier bereits die vollstaendige,\n    /// unveraendert an die WebUI durchreichbare Antwortform der jeweiligen\n    /// Route — der Aufrufer muss das JSON nicht mehr zusammensetzen.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// - `organization_id` (`Uuid`): Mandant, an den die Edge-Kopfzeilen\n    ///   gebunden werden; muss aus den bereits verifizierten Admin-Claims\n    ///   des Aufrufers stammen, niemals aus Nutzereingabe.\n    /// - `name` (`&str`): Werkzeugname, z. B. `\"get_ai_monitor\"`.\n    /// - `arguments` (`Value`): `params.arguments` des JSON-RPC-Aufrufs.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Ok(Value)` — der `result`-Teil der JSON-RPC-Antwort, unveraendert.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::SecretMissing`] — `SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN` oder\n    ///   `PARTICIPANT_SGH_ACCT_AUTH_TOKEN_SECRET` fehlt oder ist leer.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::TokenMint`] — die Edge-Signatur liess sich nicht\n    ///   berechnen.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::Transport`] — `sgh-acctd` nicht erreichbar.\n    /// - [`AcctClientError::HttpStatus`] — Nicht-2xx-Antwort oder ein\n    ///   JSON-RPC-`error`-Umschlag (als Status `502` gemeldet).\n    /// -
