Deterministic assembly of a SAP-postable BAPI document from invoice data, with a\n//! typestate that makes emitting an unbalanced document impossible.\n//!\n//! ## Responsibility\n//!\n//! This module owns the mapping from the storage-side invoice model\n//! ([`InvoiceHeader`] + [`InvoicePosition`]s) onto the wire-format structs in\n//! [`crate::bapi::model`], plus the balance invariant that guards posting. It owns\n//! no I/O and performs no SAP submission — it only produces the\n//! [`crate::bapi::model::BapiDocument`] value a transport layer sends.\n//!\n//! ## Key types exported\n//!\n//! - [`assemble`] — the single entry point; builds a [`Bapi<Draft>`].\n//! - [`Bapi<State>`] — a BAPI document parameterized by its validation state.\n//! - [`Draft`] — typestate marker for an assembled, not-yet-validated document.\n//! - [`Balanced`] — typestate marker for a balance-validated, postable document.\n//!\n//! ## The headline invariant\n//!\n//! The owned SAP payload is reachable **only** via\n//! [`Bapi::<Balanced>::into_document`], and the **only** way to obtain a\n//! [`Bapi<Balanced>`] is [`Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance`], which returns an error\n//! unless total debits equal total credits. Consequently an unbalanced document can\n//! never be emitted — the compiler enforces it through the typestate, not a runtime\n//! convention.\n//!\n//! ## Concurrency\n//!\n//! All types are plain data and `Send + Sync`. [`assemble`] is a pure, synchronous\n//! function with no shared state; it emits `tracing::warn!` events for recoverable\n//! fallbacks (e.g. a defaulted company code) but acquires no locks and spawns no\n//! threads.\n//!\n//! ## Errors\n//!\n//! Fallible operations return [`BapiResult<T>`]. [`assemble`] can yield\n//! [`BapiError::MissingHeaderField`], [`BapiError::MissingGlAccount`], and\n//! [`BapiError::NoPostableLines`]; [`Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance`] can yield\n//! [`BapiError::UnbalancedDocument`].\n//!\n//! ## Examples\n//!\n//! ```rust,no_run\n//! use sgh_flow::bapi::builder::assemble;\n//! use sgh_flow::domain::{InvoiceHeader, InvoicePosition};\n//!\n//! # fn demo(header: InvoiceHeader, positions: Vec<InvoicePosition>) -> sgh_flow::bapi::error::BapiResult<()> {\n//! // Full pipeline: assemble -> validate balance -> extract SAP payload.\n//! let document = assemble(&header, &positions)?\n//!     .validate_balance()?\n//!     .into_document();\n//! assert_eq!(document.bapi, \"BAPI_ACC_DOCUMENT_POST\");\n//! # Ok(())\n//! # }\n//! ```\n\nuse std::marker::PhantomData;\n\nuse chrono::NaiveDate;\nuse tracing::warn;\n\nuse crate::bapi::error::{BapiError, BapiResult};\nuse crate::bapi::model::{\n    AccountGl, AccountPayable, AccountTax, BapiDocument, BapiDocumentHeader, CurrencyAmount,\n};\nuse crate::domain::{InvoiceHeader, InvoicePosition, PositionType};\nuse rust_decimal::Decimal;\n\n/// Typestate marker for an assembled but not-yet-balance-checked document.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// A zero-sized marker used as the `State` parameter of [`Bapi<State>`]. A\n/// [`Bapi<Draft>`] is the only thing [`assemble`] produces; it deliberately exposes\n/// no way to extract the owned SAP payload, so a draft can never be posted directly.\n/// The sole transition out of `Draft` is [`Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance`].\npub struct Draft;\n\n/// Typestate marker for a balance-validated, SAP-postable document.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// A zero-sized marker used as the `State` parameter of [`Bapi<State>`]. A\n/// [`Bapi<Balanced>`] can only be obtained from\n/// [`Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance`], and it is the sole state that exposes\n/// [`Bapi::<Balanced>::into_document`]. Holding a `Bapi<Balanced>` is therefore a\n/// proof that debits equal credits.\npub struct Balanced;\n\n/// A BAPI document parameterized by its validation state.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Wraps a [`BapiDocument`] together with a phantom `State` that encodes how far the\n/// document has progressed through validation. `Bapi<Draft>` is produced by\n/// [`assemble`]; `Bapi<Balanced>` only by [`Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance`]. The\n/// owned SAP payload is reachable solely from the `Balanced` state via\n/// [`Bapi::<Balanced>::into_document`], which is what makes emitting an unbalanced\n/// document impossible at compile time.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Plain data; `Send + Sync`. Holds no locks and no interior mutability.\npub struct Bapi<State> {\n    document: BapiDocument,\n    _state: PhantomData<State>,\n}\n\nimpl<State> Bapi<State> {\n    /// Borrows the underlying document for inspection, in any state.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Read-only access to the wrapped [`BapiDocument`], available in both `Draft`\n    /// and `Balanced` states. Borrowing never changes the typestate, so inspecting a\n    /// draft does not let a caller bypass [`validate_balance`](Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance).\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `&BapiDocument` — a shared borrow of the wrapped document.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```rust,no_run\n    /// # use sgh_flow::bapi::builder::assemble;\n    /// # use sgh_flow::domain::{InvoiceHeader, InvoicePosition};\n    /// # fn demo(header: InvoiceHeader, positions: Vec<InvoicePosition>) -> sgh_flow::bapi::error::BapiResult<()> {\n    /// let draft = assemble(&header, &positions)?;\n    /// assert!(!draft.document().account_gl.is_empty());\n    /// # Ok(())\n    /// # }\n    /// ```\n    pub fn document(&self) -> &BapiDocument {\n        &self.document\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Bapi<Draft> {\n    /// Validates that total debits equal total credits, advancing to [`Balanced`].\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Sums the signed amounts across every `CURRENCYAMOUNT` line: positive amounts\n    /// accrue to debits, negative amounts (by magnitude) to credits. When the two\n    /// totals are equal the draft is consumed and a [`Bapi<Balanced>`] is returned —\n    /// the only state from which a SAP payload can be extracted. This is the single\n    /// transition out of the [`Draft`] state.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `Bapi<Balanced>` — the same document, re-typed as balance-validated and\n    /// therefore postable.\n    ///\n    /// # Errors\n    ///\n    /// - [`BapiError::UnbalancedDocument`] — the sum of positive amounts does not\n    ///   equal the sum of (absolute) negative amounts; both totals are reported.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```rust,no_run\n    /// # use sgh_flow::bapi::builder::assemble;\n    /// # use sgh_flow::domain::{InvoiceHeader, InvoicePosition};\n    /// # fn demo(header: InvoiceHeader, positions: Vec<InvoicePosition>) -> sgh_flow::bapi::error::BapiResult<()> {\n    /// let document = assemble(&header, &positions)?\n    ///     .validate_balance()? // errors with UnbalancedDocument if it does not net to zero\n    ///     .into_document();\n    /// # let _ = document;\n    /// # Ok(())\n    /// # }\n    /// ```\n    pub fn validate_balance(self) -> BapiResult<Bapi<Balanced>> {\n        let mut debit = Decimal::ZERO;\n        let mut credit = Decimal::ZERO;\n        for amount in &self.document.currency_amount {\n            if amount.amt_doccur.is_sign_negative() {\n                credit -= amount.amt_doccur; // subtract a negative -> add magnitude\n            } else {\n                debit += amount.amt_doccur;\n            }\n        }\n        if debit != credit {\n            return Err(BapiError::UnbalancedDocument { debit, credit });\n        }\n        Ok(Bapi {\n            document: self.document,\n            _state: PhantomData,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Bapi<Balanced> {\n    /// Consumes the balanced document, yielding the SAP-postable payload.\n    ///\n    /// # Description\n    ///\n    /// Unwraps the inner [`BapiDocument`] for submission to SAP. This method exists\n    /// only on `Bapi<Balanced>`, so the type system guarantees that any document a\n    /// caller can extract has already passed\n    /// [`validate_balance`](Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance) — an unbalanced payload\n    /// is unreachable here.\n    ///\n    /// # Returns\n    ///\n    /// `BapiDocument` — the owned, balance-validated SAP payload.\n    ///\n    /// # Examples\n    ///\n    /// ```rust,no_run\n    /// # use sgh_flow::bapi::builder::assemble;\n    /// # use sgh_flow::domain::{InvoiceHeader, InvoicePosition};\n    /// # fn demo(header: InvoiceHeader, positions: Vec<InvoicePosition>) -> sgh_flow::bapi::error::BapiResult<()> {\n    /// let document = assemble(&header, &positions)?.validate_balance()?.into_document();\n    /// // `document` is now ready to serialize and post to SAP.\n    /// # let _ = document;\n    /// # Ok(())\n    /// # }\n    /// ```\n    pub fn into_document(self) -> BapiDocument {\n        self.document\n    }\n}\n\n// INTERNAL: format a date as SAP `DATS` (`YYYYMMDD`, zero-padded). Private helper\n// shared by header- and line-level date conversion in `assemble`.\nfn fmt_sap_date(date: NaiveDate) -> String {\n    date.format(\"%Y%m%d\").to_string()\n}\n\n/// Assembles a draft BAPI document from an invoice header and its positions.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Maps the storage-side invoice model onto the SAP wire format and returns a\n/// [`Bapi<Draft>`]. A draft is intentionally not postable: the SAP payload can only\n/// be extracted after [`Bapi::<Draft>::validate_balance`] confirms debits equal\n/// credits, so this function alone can never emit an unbalanced document.\n///\n/// Each amount-bearing position contributes a `CURRENCYAMOUNT`. Positions route to\n/// BAPI sections by [`PositionType`]: `Payable` → `ACCOUNTPAYABLE`,\n/// `Tax` → `ACCOUNTTAX`, and everything else (`Gl`, `Allowance`, `PaymentTerm`,\n/// `Other`) → `ACCOUNTGL` as a posting line. Every GL line requires a decided\n/// `gl_account` — SAP cannot post without one. Missing optional header fields are\n/// filled from fallbacks (e.g. `currency` falls back to a position currency,\n/// `company_code` defaults to `\"001\"` with a `tracing::warn!`).\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `header` (`&InvoiceHeader`): borrowed invoice header supplying document-level\n///   metadata (company code, document type, dates, references).\n/// - `positions` (`&[InvoicePosition]`): borrowed slice of line positions; each is\n///   routed to a BAPI section by its [`PositionType`] and may contribute an amount.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// `Bapi<Draft>` — an assembled draft document awaiting balance validation.\n///\n/// # Errors\n///\n/// - [`BapiError::MissingHeaderField`] — `doc_type`, `currency`, `doc_date`, or\n///   `posting_date` is absent on the header (and no fallback resolves it).\n/// - [`BapiError::MissingGlAccount`] — a GL-routed position has no `gl_account`.\n/// - [`BapiError::NoPostableLines`] — no GL lines were produced.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Pure and synchronous; safe to call from any thread. Holds no shared state.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// use sgh_flow::bapi::builder::assemble;\n/// use sgh_flow::domain::{InvoiceHeader, InvoicePosition};\n///\n/// # fn demo(header: InvoiceHeader, positions: Vec<InvoicePosition>) -> sgh_flow::bapi::error::BapiResult<()> {\n/// let draft = assemble(&header, &positions)?;\n/// // A draft must be balance-validated before its payload can be extracted.\n/// let document = draft.validate_balance()?.into_document();\n/// # let _ = document;\n/// # Ok(())\n/// # }\n/// ```\npub fn assemble(header: &InvoiceHeader, positions: &[InvoicePosition]) -> BapiResult<Bapi<Draft>> {\n    let doc_type = header\n        .doc_type\n        .clone()\n        .ok_or(BapiError::MissingHeaderField { field: \"doc_type\" })?;\n    let currency = header\n        .currency\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| positions.iter().find_map(|p| p.currency.clone()))\n        .ok_or(BapiError::MissingHeaderField { field: \"currency\" })?;\n    let doc_date = header\n        .doc_date\n        .or(header.issue_date)\n        .map(fmt_sap_date)\n        .ok_or(BapiError::MissingHeaderField { field: \"doc_date\" })?;\n    let pstng_date = header\n        .posting_date\n        .or(header.doc_date)\n        .or(header.issue_date)\n        .map(fmt_sap_date)\n        .ok_or(BapiError::MissingHeaderField {\n            field: \"posting_date\",\n        })?;\n\n    let comp_code = header.company_code.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {\n        warn!(invoice_id = %header.id, \"invoice header missing company_code; defaulting to \\\"001\\\"\");\n        \"001\".to_string()\n    });\n    let ref_doc_no = header\n        .ref_doc_no\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| header.invoice_number.clone())\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| header.id.to_string());\n    let bus_act = header.bus_act.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| \"RFBU\".to_string());\n    let header_txt = header\n        .header_text\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| header.vendor_name.clone())\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n\n    let document_header = BapiDocumentHeader {\n        bus_act,\n        comp_code,\n        doc_type,\n        doc_date,\n        pstng_date,\n        header_txt,\n        ref_doc_no,\n    };\n\n    let mut account_payable = Vec::new();\n    let mut account_gl = Vec::new();\n    let mut account_tax = Vec::new();\n    let mut currency_amount = Vec::new();\n\n    for pos in positions {\n        if let Some(amt) = pos.amt_doccur {\n            currency_amount.push(CurrencyAmount {\n                itemno_acc: pos.itemno_acc,\n                curr_type: pos.curr_type.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| \"00\".to_string()),\n                currency: pos.currency.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| currency.clone()),\n                amt_doccur: amt,\n                amt_base: pos.amt_base,\n            });\n        }\n\n        match pos.position_type {\n            PositionType::Tax => account_tax.push(AccountTax {\n                itemno_acc: pos.itemno_acc,\n                tax_code: pos.tax_code.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                taxjurcode: String::new(),\n                acct_key: String::new(),\n                gl_account: pos.gl_account.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n            }),\n            PositionType::Payable => account_payable.push(AccountPayable {\n                itemno_acc: pos.itemno_acc,\n                vendor_no: pos\n                    .vendor_no\n                    .clone()\n                    .or_else(|| header.vendor_no.clone())\n                    .unwrap_or_default(),\n                pmnttrms: pos.payment_terms.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                bline_date: pos.baseline_date.map(fmt_sap_date).unwrap_or_default(),\n                pmnt_block: pos.payment_block.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                pymt_meth: pos.payment_method.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                partner_bk: pos.partner_bank.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                alloc_nmbr: pos.alloc_number.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n            }),\n            // Gl, Allowance, PaymentTerm, Other all post as GL lines (full document).\n            _ => {\n                let gl_account = pos.gl_account.clone().ok_or(BapiError::MissingGlAccount {\n                    itemno_acc: pos.itemno_acc,\n                })?;\n                account_gl.push(AccountGl {\n                    itemno_acc: pos.itemno_acc,\n                    gl_account,\n                    costcenter: pos.cost_center.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    orderid: pos.order_id.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    wbs_element: pos.wbs_element.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    profit_ctr: pos.profit_ctr.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    func_area: pos.func_area.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    segment: pos.segment.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    item_text: pos\n                        .item_text\n                        .clone()\n                        .or_else(|| pos.description.clone())\n                        .unwrap_or_default(),\n                    tax_code: pos.tax_code.clone().unwrap_or_default(),\n                    itemno_tax: pos.itemno_tax,\n                    // InvoicePosition carries no tax-rate/tax-category fields yet;\n                    // resolution against sgh-acct's tax catalog is tracked separately.\n                    tax_rate_percent: None,\n                    tax_category: None,\n                    // InvoicePosition carries no net/tax-amount fields yet (Welle 10,\n                    // F3); the extractor populates NET_AMOUNT/TAX_AMOUNT directly on\n                    // the ACCOUNTGL entries it builds, bypassing this assembler path.\n                    net_amount: None,\n                    tax_amount: None,\n                });\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if account_gl.is_empty() {\n        return Err(BapiError::NoPostableLines);\n    }\n\n    let document = BapiDocument {\n Decision API endpoint for recording accounting decisions on invoices.\n//!\n//! # Responsibility\n//!\n//! This module owns:\n//! - REST endpoint for recording decisions (`POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/decisions`)\n//! - Request validation and deserialization\n//! - Integration with `DecisionService`\n//!\n//! Does NOT own:\n//! - Decision persistence logic (delegated to `DecisionService`)\n//! - Iceberg writes (delegated to `IcebergSyncService` via service)\n//!\n//! # Workflow\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! 1. Client sends POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/decisions\n//! 2. Handler validates bearer token and OPERATOR scope\n//! 3. Handler deserializes JSON body into CreateDecisionRequest\n//! 4. Handler calls decision_service.record_decision()\n//! 5. Returns 201 Created with DecisionRecord as JSON\n//! ```\n//!\n//! # Akteur-Zurechnung (`decided_by` / `actor_type`)\n//!\n//! Beide Endpunkte dieses Moduls schreiben in `invoice_decisions` — die\n//! autoritative Entscheidungstabelle (die generische `decisions`-Tabelle wird\n//! davon nur best-effort gespiegelt, siehe\n//! `db::repositories::decision::PgDecisionRepository::insert`). Der Akteur darf\n//! deshalb nicht aus dem Anfragekoerper uebernommen werden.\n//!\n//! ## Warum `decided_by` hier ein `String` ist\n//!\n//! Die Spalte ist `VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL`\n//! (`migrations/20260415100001_create_invoice_decisions.sql:10`; die aeltere\n//! `migrations/202504150001_add_invoice_decisions.sql:10` deklariert sie als\n//! `TEXT NOT NULL`) — sie ist keine `UUID`-Spalte und enthaelt im Bestand\n//! nachweislich Nicht-UUID-Werte: der Auto-Accept-Pfad schreibt die Kennung\n//! `\"system:auto-accept\"` (`websocket/session.rs:1382`). Der Spaltentyp bleibt\n//! deshalb unangetastet; eingeengt wird nur, was ueber HTTP neu hereinkommt.\n//!\n//! ## Wer diesen Endpunkt bedient\n//!\n//! Ausschliesslich Menschen mit Nutzer-Token. Es existiert im Baum kein\n//! Dienst-/Stellvertreteraufruf auf `POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/decisions`:\n//!\n//! - Der Participant `sgh-acct` schreibt Entscheidungen ueber den **generischen**\n//!   Endpunkt `POST /api/v1/decisions`\n//!   (`sgh-acct/crates/sgh-acct-service/src/platform_client.rs:403`,\n//!   `.../services/decisions.rs::PlatformDecisionSink`), nicht hierher.\n//! - Die systemseitigen Schreiber gehen am Handler vorbei und bauen ihr\n//!   [`DecisionInsert`] im Prozess: Auto-Accept\n//!   (`websocket/session.rs:1378-1396`, `actor_type = \"SYSTEM\"`) und der\n//!   MCP-Pfad (`mcp/tools/decisions.rs:824-835`, direktes `INSERT`).\n//!\n//! Darum gibt es hier **keine** Dienstsonderbehandlung wie in\n//! [`crate::api::decision_generic`] — sie waere Vorrat ohne Aufrufer. Aus\n//! demselben Grund bleibt `actor_type` fest auf [`ACTOR_TYPE_HUMAN`]: der\n//! einzige Weg durch diesen Handler ist ein menschlicher. `actor_type` wird\n//! ausserdem gar nicht persistiert (die Tabelle hat keine solche Spalte, siehe\n//! `db::repositories::decision::DecisionInsert`) — es beschriftet nur das\n//! Audit-Ereignis.\n//!\n//! ## Die Regel\n//!\n//! [`resolve_actor`] ist fuer beide Pfade die einzige Quelle des Akteurs:\n//!\n//! | Angabe im Koerper | Ergebnis |\n//! |---|---|\n//! | fehlt | `claims.sub` |\n//! | gleiche UUID wie `claims.sub` (auch in anderer Schreibweise) | `claims.sub`, kanonisch normalisiert |\n//! | abweichende UUID | `400` ([`ActorRejection::ForeignDecidedBy`]) |\n//! | Nil-UUID | `400` ([`ActorRejection::NilDecidedBy`]), vor Protokoll und Repository |\n//! | keine UUID (z. B. eine E-Mail) | `400` ([`ActorRejection::NonUuidDecidedBy`]) |\n//!\n//! Der letzte Fall ist der Unterschied zur Vorlage: weil die Spalte Text ist,\n//! kann ein Aufrufer eine beliebige Zeichenkette behaupten, und gegen\n//! `claims.sub` — eine UUID — laesst sich eine E-Mail oder ein Benutzername\n//! nicht pruefen. Ein Abgleich ueber eine Benutzertabelle findet hier bewusst\n//! nicht statt: er waere ein zweiter Datenbanktreffer im Schreibpfad und wuerde\n//! die Zurechnung von einer Tabelle abhaengig machen, die der Aufrufer\n//! mitbestimmt. Stattdessen wird eine nicht-UUID-foermige Behauptung abgelehnt;\n//! wer seine eigene Kennung nicht wiederholen will, laesst das Feld weg.\n//! Bestandszeilen bleiben davon unberuehrt — die Regel greift nur beim\n//! Schreiben ueber HTTP.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse http::{Request, StatusCode};\nuse hyper::body::Incoming;\nuse serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse sgh_flow_auth::scope;\n\nuse crate::{\n    app::AppContext,\n    db::repositories::{DecisionInsert, InvoiceItemRow},\n    error::AppResult,\n    server::{\n        auth_extractor::{extract_claims, require_scopes},\n        handler::{HandlerResult, error_response, handler, json_response},\n        router::insert_route,\n    },\n    services::auth::AuthClaims,\n};\n\n/// Akteurstyp eines Menschen — der einzige Wert, der durch diesen Handler\n/// entstehen kann (siehe Modul-Dokumentation, „Wer diesen Endpunkt bedient\").\npub const ACTOR_TYPE_HUMAN: &str = \"HUMAN\";\n\n/// Request body for creating a new decision.\n#[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]\npub struct CreateDecisionRequest {\n    /// Optional proposal ID this decision is based on\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub proposal_id: Option<Uuid>,\n\n    /// Kennung des Entscheiders. Optional: fehlt das Feld, wird es aus\n    /// `claims.sub` gefuellt. Wird es gesetzt, muss es die eigene Kennung in\n    /// UUID-Form sein — jede andere Angabe wird mit `400` abgelehnt statt still\n    /// ueberschrieben. Siehe [`resolve_actor`] und die Modul-Dokumentation.\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub decided_by: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Decision type: \"approved\", \"declined\", \"override\"\n    pub decision_type: String,\n\n    /// GL account code\n    pub gl_account: String,\n\n    /// Optional cost center\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub cost_center: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Optional tax treatment\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub tax_treatment: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Optional reason for override (required if decision_type is \"override\")\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub override_reason: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Optional notes\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub notes: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Optional invoice item ID this decision applies to\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub invoice_item_id: Option<Uuid>,\n\n    /// Optional final account name\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub final_account_name: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Optional item number account\n    #[serde(default)]\n    pub itemno_acc: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Der aufgeloeste, nicht mehr behauptbare Akteur einer Entscheidung.\n///\n/// Ergebnis von [`resolve_actor`]; beide Handler dieses Moduls uebernehmen die\n/// Felder unveraendert in [`DecisionInsert`], damit es nur einen Weg gibt, wie\n/// ein Akteur in `invoice_decisions` gelangt.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct ResolvedActor {\n    /// Kennung des Entscheiders in kanonischer UUID-Textform. Nie leer — die\n    /// Spalte ist `NOT NULL` und `claims.sub` ist immer vorhanden.\n    pub decided_by: String,\n    /// Beschriftung des Audit-Ereignisses. Aus diesem Handler stets\n    /// [`ACTOR_TYPE_HUMAN`]; das Feld existiert, damit ein spaeterer\n    /// Dienstpfad genau hier landet statt an den Aufrufstellen.\n    pub actor_type: &'static str,\n}\n\n/// Gruende, aus denen eine behauptete Akteurs-Angabe abgelehnt wird.\n///\n/// Jede Variante fuehrt zu `400 BAD_REQUEST`. Abweichende Angaben werden nicht\n/// still ueberschrieben, sonst glaubt der Aufrufer, seine Zurechnung sei\n/// angekommen.\n#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ActorRejection {\n    /// Der Aufrufer hat eine fremde Kennung als `decided_by` behauptet.\n    ForeignDecidedBy {\n        /// Die im Koerper behauptete Kennung.\n        claimed: Uuid,\n        /// Die tatsaechliche Kennung aus den Claims.\n        actual: Uuid,\n    },\n    /// `decided_by` war die Nil-UUID — keine gueltige Identitaet\n    /// (AGENTS.md, „UUID identity and RLS — no nil sentinels\", Z. 132-151).\n    NilDecidedBy,\n    /// `decided_by` war keine UUID. Die Spalte ist Text, die Identitaet im\n    /// Token ist eine UUID — eine freie Zeichenkette ist gegen sie nicht\n    /// pruefbar und damit nicht zurechenbar.\n    NonUuidDecidedBy {\n        /// Die im Koerper behauptete Zeichenkette.\n        claimed: String,\n    },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ActorRejection {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Self::ForeignDecidedBy { .. } => f.write_str(\n                \"decided_by must match the authenticated subject; \\\n                 omit the field to have it filled from the token\",\n            ),\n            Self::NilDecidedBy => f.write_str(\"decided_by must not be the nil UUID\"),\n            Self::NonUuidDecidedBy { .. } => f.write_str(\n                \"decided_by must be the authenticated subject's UUID; \\\n                 omit the field to have it filled from the token\",\n            ),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Debug delegiert an Display — eine Implementierung, keine Doppelpflege.\nimpl std::fmt::Debug for ActorRejection {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        std::fmt::Display::fmt(self, f)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for ActorRejection {\n    fn source(&self) -> Option<&(dyn std::error::Error + 'static)> {\n        None\n    }\n}\n\n/// Leitet den unfaelschbaren Akteur aus den Claims und der behaupteten Angabe ab.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Einzige Quelle des Akteurs fuer beide Handler dieses Moduls. Der Endpunkt\n/// wird nur von Menschen bedient (Belege in der Modul-Dokumentation), also gibt\n/// es keinen Stellvertreterfall: das Ergebnis ist immer `claims.sub`, und eine\n/// abweichende Behauptung ist ein Fehler statt einer stillen Korrektur.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n/// - `claims` (`&AuthClaims`): die verifizierten Token-Claims.\n/// - `claimed_decided_by` (`Option<&str>`): `decided_by` aus dem Anfragekoerper.\n///\n/// # Returns\n/// [`ResolvedActor`] mit `decided_by` in kanonischer UUID-Textform und\n/// `actor_type` = [`ACTOR_TYPE_HUMAN`].\n///\n/// # Errors\n/// - [`ActorRejection::NonUuidDecidedBy`]: die Angabe ist keine UUID.\n/// - [`ActorRejection::NilDecidedBy`]: die Angabe ist die Nil-UUID.\n/// - [`ActorRejection::ForeignDecidedBy`]: die Angabe ist eine fremde UUID.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n/// Reine Funktion ohne geteilten Zustand — aus beliebig vielen Tasks aufrufbar.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// // Ohne Angabe im Koerper traegt die Entscheidung die Kennung aus dem Token:\n/// // let actor = resolve_actor(&claims, None)?;\n/// // assert_eq!(actor.decided_by, claims.sub.to_string());\n/// ```\nfn resolve_actor(\n    claims: &AuthClaims,\n    claimed_decided_by: Option<&str>,\n) -> std::result::Result<ResolvedActor, ActorRejection> {\n    // Der Akteur des Tokens ist die einzige belastbare Kennung; alles andere\n    // muss sich als genau diese ausweisen.\n    let resolved = ResolvedActor {\n        decided_by: claims.sub.to_string(),\n        actor_type: ACTOR_TYPE_HUMAN,\n    };\n\n    let Some(claimed) = claimed_decided_by.map(str::trim).filter(|c| !c.is_empty()) else {\n        return Ok(resolved);\n    };\n\n    // Nicht-UUID-Behauptungen kommen gar nicht erst zum Vergleich: gegen eine\n    // UUID im Token ist eine E-Mail oder ein Benutzername nicht pruefbar.\n    let Ok(claimed_uuid) = Uuid::parse_str(claimed) else {\n        return Err(ActorRejection::NonUuidDecidedBy {\n            claimed: claimed.to_owned(),\n        });\n    };\n\n    // Nil vor Protokoll und Repository abweisen — sie ist nie eine Identitaet.\n    if claimed_uuid.is_nil() {\n        return Err(ActorRejection::NilDecidedBy);\n    }\n\n    if claimed_uuid != claims.sub {\n        return Err(ActorRejection::ForeignDecidedBy {\n            claimed: claimed_uuid,\n            actual: claims.sub,\n        });\n    }\n\n    Ok(resolved)\n}\n\n/// Response body for a created decision.\n#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]\npub struct CreateDecisionResponse {\n    /// Unique ID assigned to this decision\n    pub decision_id: Uuid,\n\n    /// Document ID this decision applies to\n    pub document_id: Uuid,\n\n    /// Timestamp when the decision was recorded\n    pub decided_at: String,\n\n    /// Decision type\n    pub decision_type: String,\n\n    /// GL account code\n    pub gl_account: String,\n}\n\nhandler!(create_decision_handler, create_decision_impl);\n\n/// Create a decision for an invoice.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// This endpoint allows users with OPERATOR scope to record accounting decisions\n/// on invoices. The decision is:\n/// 1. Persisted in PostgreSQL\n/// 2. Synced to Iceberg for analytics (fire-and-forget)\n/// 3. Published as an event via the dispatcher\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `req` — Raw Hyper request with JSON body\n/// - `params` — Path parameters containing `{invoice_id}`\n/// - `state` — Application context with decision service\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `HandlerResult` — 201 Created with JSON body containing decision record\n///\n/// # Errors\n///\n/// - `401 UNAUTHORIZED` — Missing or invalid bearer token\n/// - `403 FORBIDDEN` — User lacks OPERATOR scope\n/// - `400 BAD_REQUEST` — Invalid JSON body, missing required fields, or a\n///   forged actor attribution: a `decided_by` the caller's token does not\n///   entitle it to claim (see [`ActorRejection`])\n/// - `500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` — Database or processing failure\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Thread-safe. Multiple requests can be processed concurrently.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// `decided_by` wird bewusst weggelassen — die Kennung kommt aus dem Token.\n///\n/// ```bash\n/// curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/decisions \\\n///   -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\\n///   -H \"Authorization: Bearer <JWT>\" \\\n///   -d '{\n///     \"decision_type\": \"approved\",\n///     \"gl_account\": \"4000\",\n///     \"cost_center\": \"CC-001\",\n///     \"notes\": \"Approved after review\"\n///   }'\n/// ```\nasync fn create_decision_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    use tracing::{error, info, warn};\n\n    // Extract and validate bearer token\n    let claims = match extract_claims(&req, &state) {\n        Ok(c) => c,\n        Err(err_response) => return err_response,\n    };\n\n    if let Err(err_response) = require_scopes(&claims, &[scope::INVOICES_APPROVE]) {\n        return err_response;\n    }\n\n    // Extract invoice_id from path\n    let invoice_id_str = match params.get(\"invoice_id\") {\n        Some(id) => id,\n        None => {\n            error!(\"missing invoice_id in path params\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,\n                \"Missing invoice_id in path parameters\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    let invoice_id = match Uuid::parse_str(invoice_id_str) {\n        Ok(id) => id,\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, invoice_id_str = %invoice_id_str, \"failed to parse invoice_id\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,\n                &format!(\"Invalid invoice_id format: {}\", err),\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Enforce same-organization decision ownership.\n    let invoice_org_id = match sqlx::query_scalar::<_, Uuid>(\n        r#\"SELECT organization_id FROM invoice_ingest WHERE id = $1\"#,\n    )\n    .bind(invoice_id)\n    .fetch_optional(state.db_pool.inner())\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(Some(org_id)) => org_id,\n        Ok(None) => {\n            match sqlx::query_scalar::<_, Uuid>(\n                r#\"SELECT organization_id FROM invoice_header WHERE id = $1\"#,\n            )\n            .bind(invoice_id)\n            .fetch_optional(state.db_pool.inner())\n            .await\n            {\n                Ok(Some(org_id)) => org_id,\n                Ok(None) => {\n                    return error_response(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, \"Invoice not found\");\n                }\n                Err(err) => {\n                    error!(error = %err, invoice_id = %invoice_id, \"failed to fetch invoice organization from invoice_header\");\n                    return error_response(\n                        StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                        \"Failed to validate invoice organization\",\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, invoice_id = %invoice_id, \"failed to fetch invoice organization from invoice_ingest\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to validate invoice organization\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    if invoice_org_id != claims.organization_id {\n        return error_response(\n            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,\n            \"Cannot create decisions for invoices outside your organization\",\n        );\n    }\n\n    // Parse JSON body (SEC-03 Phase 5 audit: 16 KiB cap).\n    let body_bytes = match crate::server::handler::read_body_with_limit(req, 16 * 1024).await {\n        Ok(b) => b,\n        Err(resp) => return resp,\n    };\n\n    let body: CreateDecisionRequest = match serde_json::from_slice(&body_bytes) {\n        Ok(parsed) => parsed,\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, \"failed to parse JSON body\");\n            return error_response(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, \"Invalid JSON body\");\n        }\n    };\n\n    // Der Akteur wird abgeleitet, nicht uebernommen — sonst koennte jeder\n    // Aufrufer mit `invoices:approve` eine Entscheidung in der autoritativen\n    // Tabelle einem fremden Nutzer zuschreiben.\n    let actor = match resolve_actor(&claims, body.decided_by.as_deref()) {\n        Ok(resolved) => resolved,\n        Err(rejection) => {\n            warn!(\n                organization_id = %claims.organization_id,\n                invoice_id = %invoice_id,\n                decision_type = %body.decision_type,\n                claimed_decided_by = ?body.decided_by,\n                authenticated_subject = %claims.sub,\n                reason = %rejection,\n                \"rejected invoice decision with a forged actor attribution\"\n            );\n            return error_response(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, &rejection.to_string());\n        }\n    };\n\n    info!(\n        invoice_id = %invoice_id,\n        decision_type = %body.decision_type,\n        decided_by = %actor.decided_by,\n        actor_type = %actor.actor_type,\n        gl_account = %body.gl_account,\n        \"creating decision\"\n    );\n\n    // Build DecisionInsert\n    let insert = DecisionInsert {\n        document_id: invoice_id,\n        proposal_id: body.proposal_id,\n        decided_by: actor.decided_by,\n        decision_type: body.decision_type,\n        gl_account: body.gl_account,\n        cost_center: body.cost_center,\n        tax_treatment: body.tax_treatment,\n        override_reason: body.override_reason,\n        notes: body.notes,\n        invoice_item_id: body.invoice_item_id,\n        final_account_name: body.final_account_name,\n        itemno_acc: body.itemno_acc,\n        organization_id: claims.organization_id,\n        actor_type: actor.actor_type.to_owned(),\n    };\n\n    // Record decision via service\n    let record = match state.decision_service.record_decision(insert).await {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, invoice_id = %invoice_id, \"failed to record decision\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                &format!(\"Failed to record decision: {}\", err),\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    info!(\n        decision_id = %record.id,\n        invoice_id = %invoice_id,\n        \"decision created successfully\"\n    );\n\n    // Build response\n    let response = CreateDecisionResponse {\n        decision_id: record.id,\n        document_id: record.document_id,\n        decided_at: record.decided_at.to_rfc3339(),\n        decision_type: record.decision_type,\n        gl_account: record.gl_account,\n    };\n\n    match serde_json::to_value(response) {\n        Ok(v) => json_response(StatusCode::CREATED, &v),\n        Err(e) => {\n            error!(error = %e, \"failed to serialize decision response\");\n            error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"failed to serialize response\",\n            )\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Select the best available GL account proposal from an invoice item row.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// Chooses the GL account and its human-readable name to promote into an\n/// `invoice_decisions` row during the approve workflow.  Preference order:\n///\n/// 1. `final_gl_account` + `final_account_name` — set when a reviewer has\n///    explicitly confirmed or overridden the AI suggestion.\n/// 2. `hypothesis_gl_account` + `hypothesis_account_name` — the raw AI\n///    prediction, used as a fallback when no final value has been written.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `item` (`&InvoiceItemRow`): the line-item row to inspect.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `Some((gl_account, account_name))` — a GL code was available; `account_name`\n///   is `None` when no display name is present.\n/// - `None` — both `final_gl_account` and `hypothesis_gl_account` are `None`;\n///   the item carries no AI proposal and should be skipped.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Pure function; no shared state.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```rust,no_run\n/// use sgh_flow::db::repositories::InvoiceItemRow;\n/// use sgh_flow::api::decision::select_proposal_gl;\n///\n/// // final_gl_account wins over hypothesis\n/// // if let Some((gl, _name)) = select_proposal_gl(&item) {\n/// //     assert_eq!(gl, \"4711\");\n/// // }\n/// ```\npub fn select_proposal_gl(item: &InvoiceItemRow) -> Option<(String, Option<String>)> {\n    let gl = item\n        .final_gl_account\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| item.hypothesis_gl_account.clone())?;\n    let account_name = item\n        .final_account_name\n        .clone()\n        .or_else(|| item.hypothesis_account_name.clone());\n    Some((gl, account_name))\n}\n\nhandler!(approve_invoice_handler, approve_invoice_impl);\n\n/// Approve an invoice by promoting AI proposal lines into accounting decisions.\n///\n/// # Description\n///\n/// `POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/approve`\n///\n/// For each invoice item that has an AI-generated GL proposal (`final_gl_account`\n/// or `hypothesis_gl_account`), this handler creates one `invoice_decisions` row\n/// with `decision_type = \"approve\"`.  The resulting decisions are overlaid by the\n/// `/bapi` endpoint when assembling the BAPI document for posting.\n///\n/// Workflow:\n/// 1. Validate bearer token and `invoices:approve` scope.\n/// 2. Parse `{invoice_id}` from the URL path.\n/// 3. Resolve invoice organization; return `403 FORBIDDEN` if the invoice belongs\n///    to a different organization than the caller.\n/// 4. List all `invoice_item` rows for the invoice.\n/// 5. For each item, pick the best GL proposal via [`select_proposal_gl`]; skip\n///    items with no proposal.\n/// 6. Call `decision_service.record_decision` for each selected line.\n/// 7. Return `201 Created` with `{ invoice_id, decisions_created, decision_ids }`.\n/// 8. If no items had a GL proposal, return `409 Conflict`.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `req` (`Request<Incoming>`): raw Hyper request; bearer token extracted from\n///   the `Authorization` header.\n/// - `params` (`matchit::Params`): path parameters; must contain `invoice_id`.\n/// - `state` (`Arc<AppContext>`): application context with DB pool, item repo, and\n///   decision service.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `201 Created` — `{ \"invoice_id\": \"<uuid>\", \"decisions_created\": N, \"decision_ids\": [...] }`\n///\n/// # Errors\n///\n/// - `401 UNAUTHORIZED` — Missing or invalid bearer token.\n/// - `403 FORBIDDEN` — Caller lacks `invoices:approve` scope, or the invoice\n///   belongs to a different organization.\n/// - `400 BAD_REQUEST` — `invoice_id` is not a valid UUID, or the actor could\n///   not be resolved from the token (see [`ActorRejection`]).\n/// - `404 NOT_FOUND` — Invoice does not exist.\n/// - `409 CONFLICT` — Invoice has no AI proposal lines to approve.\n/// - `500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` — Database or service failure.\n///\n/// # Concurrency\n///\n/// Thread-safe. Multiple approve requests can run concurrently; each line is\n/// inserted in its own `begin_scoped` transaction inside `DecisionService`.\n///\n/// # Examples\n///\n/// ```bash\n/// curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/approve \\\n///   -H \"Authorization: Bearer <JWT>\"\n/// ```\nasync fn approve_invoice_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    use tracing::{error, info, warn};\n\n    // 1. Extract and validate bearer token.\n    let claims = match extract_claims(&req, &state) {\n        Ok(c) => c,\n        Err(err_response) => return err_response,\n    };\n\n    if let Err(err_response) = require_scopes(&claims, &[scope::INVOICES_APPROVE]) {\n        return err_response;\n    }\n\n    // 2. Extract invoice_id from path.\n    let invoice_id_str = match params.get(\"invoice_id\") {\n        Some(id) => id,\n        None => {\n            error!(\"missing invoice_id in path params\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,\n                \"Missing invoice_id in path parameters\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    let invoice_id = match Uuid::parse_str(invoice_id_str) {\n        Ok(id) => id,\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, invoice_id_str = %invoice_id_str, \"failed to parse invoice_id\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,\n                &format!(\"Invalid invoice_id format: {}\", err),\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    // 3. Enforce same-organization ownership (mirrors create_decision_impl exactly).\n    let invoice_org_id = match sqlx::query_scalar::<_, Uuid>(\n        r#\"SELECT organization_id FROM invoice_ingest WHERE id = $1\"#,\n    )\n    .bind(invoice_id)\n    .fetch_optional(state.db_pool.inner())\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(Some(org_id)) => org_id,\n        Ok(None) => {\n            match sqlx::query_scalar::<_, Uuid>(\n                r#\"SELECT organization_id FROM invoice_header WHERE id = $1\"#,\n            )\n            .bind(invoice_id)\n            .fetch_optional(state.db_pool.inner())\n            .await\n            {\n                Ok(Some(org_id)) => org_id,\n                Ok(None) => {\n                    return error_response(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, \"Invoice not found\");\n                }\n                Err(err) => {\n                    error!(error = %err, invoice_id = %invoice_id, \"failed to fetch invoice organization from invoice_header\");\n                    return error_response(\n                        StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                        \"Failed to validate invoice organization\",\n                    );\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, invoice_id = %invoice_id, \"failed to fetch invoice organization from invoice_ingest\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to validate invoice organization\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    if invoice_org_id != claims.organization_id {\n        return error_response(\n            StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,\n            \"Cannot approve invoices outside your organization\",\n        );\n    }\n\n    // 4. List invoice items for this invoice.\n    let items = match state\n        .invoice_items\n        .list_for_invoice(invoice_id, claims.organization_id)\n        .await\n    {\n        Ok(Some(rows)) => rows,\n        Ok(None) => {\n            return error_response(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, \"Invoice items not found\");\n        }\n        Err(err) => {\n            error!(error = %err, invoice_id = %invoice_id, \"failed to list invoice items\");\n            return error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"Failed to list invoice items\",\n            );\n        }\n    };\n\n    // 5–6. For each item with a GL proposal, insert one decision row.\n    //\n    // Der Akteur laeuft ueber dieselbe Funktion wie der Einzelpfad, obwohl\n    // dieser Endpunkt keinen Koerper liest: so gibt es nur eine Stelle, die\n    // festlegt, wie eine Entscheidung zugerechnet wird. `None` heisst hier\n    // „nichts behauptet\" und ergibt genau `claims.sub`.\n    let actor = match resolve_actor(&claims, None) {\n        Ok(resolved) => resolved,\n        Err(rejection) => {\n            warn!(\n                organization_id = %claims.organization_id,\n                invoice_id = %invoice_id,\n                authenticated_subject = %claims.sub,\n                reason = %rejection,\n                \"rejected invoice approval: actor could not be resolved\"\n            );\n            return error_response(StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST, &rejection.to_string());\n        }\n    };\n\n    let mut decision_ids: Vec<Uuid> = Vec::new();\n\n    for item in &items {\n        let (gl, account_name) = match select_proposal_gl(item) {\n            Some(pair) => pair,\n            None => continue,\n        };\n\n        let insert = DecisionInsert {\n            document_id: invoice_id,\n            proposal_id: None,\n            decided_by: actor.decided_by.clone(),\n            decision_type: \"approve\".to_string(),\n            gl_account: gl,\n            cost_center: item.cost_center.clone(),\n            tax_treatment: None,\n            override_reason: None,\n            notes: None,\n            invoice_item_id: Some(item.invoice_item_id),\n            final_account_name: account_name,\n            itemno_acc: Some(item.itemno_acc.to_string()),\n            organization_id: claims.organization_id,\n            actor_type: actor.actor_type.to_owned(),\n        };\n\n        match state.decision_service.record_decision(insert).await {\n            Ok(record) => {\n                decision_ids.push(record.id);\n            }\n            Err(err) => {\n                error!(\n                    error = %err,\n                    invoice_id = %invoice_id,\n                    invoice_item_id = %item.invoice_item_id,\n Retroactive invoice **field extraction** endpoint.\n//!\n//! # Responsibility\n//!\n//! Owns a single mutating endpoint that re-runs structured field extraction on an\n//! **already-stored** invoice and persists the result into the read model, so the\n//! overview/positions surfaces populate without re-uploading the document:\n//!\n//! | Method + path | Scope | Effect |\n//! |---|---|---|\n//! | `POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/extract` | `invoices:write` | re-extract → upsert `invoice_payloads`, update `invoice_header`, (re)insert `invoice_item` |\n//!\n//! ## Why this exists\n//!\n//! For ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDFs the structured payload lives as an embedded\n//! `factur-x.xml` (CII) attachment. The upload pipeline extracts it into\n//! `invoice_payloads.json_payload` and projects the header amounts + line items —\n//! but documents ingested while the PDF extraction path was disabled were stored\n//! with an empty `{}` payload (empty overview, zero positions). This endpoint lets\n//! an operator re-run extraction **at any moment** against the durable stored\n//! bytes, so such invoices can be repaired in place.\n//!\n//! ## How extraction is re-run\n//!\n//! The raw stored bytes are fetched from S3 via the canonical\n//! `invoice_ingest.storage_path` (the same object the `GET …/pdf` handler serves).\n//! Extraction is delegated to [`crate::services::extractor::InvoiceExtractor`]:\n//!\n//! - **PDF** (`%PDF` magic): only attempted when an embedded e-invoice XML is\n//!   present (probed via\n//!   [`crate::services::extractor::extract_embedded_xml_from_pdf`]); a plain PDF\n//!   with no embedded XML yields `422` (nothing to extract — the AI agent handles\n//!   those downstream).\n//! - **XML**: parsed directly as a CII/UBL e-invoice.\n//!\n//! ## Persistence\n//!\n//! On a non-empty payload the handler, all scoped to the caller's organization:\n//! 1. upserts the latest `invoice_payloads` row's `json_payload`,\n//! 2. updates `invoice_header` net/gross/payable/currency (reusing the upload\n//!    service's [`crate::services::upload::derive_amounts_from_payload`]) and\n//!    `total_items`,\n//! 3. (re)inserts `invoice_item` rows from the BAPI `ACCOUNTGL` section\n//!    (idempotent — `ON CONFLICT (invoice_id, itemno_acc) DO NOTHING`).\n//!\n//! ## Tenant isolation\n//!\n//! The `invoice_ingest` lookup runs inside an RLS-scoped transaction and every\n//! write filters on `organization_id`, so an invoice owned by another organization\n//! is reported as `404` and never mutated.\n//!\n//! ## Errors\n//!\n//! Handlers never propagate Rust errors; all failures become structured JSON:\n//!\n//! - `400` — malformed `invoice_id`.\n//! - `401`/`403` — missing/invalid auth or scope.\n//! - `404` — invoice not visible to the caller's organization, or no stored bytes.\n//! - `415` — stored document is not parseable as an e-invoice.\n//! - `422` — plain PDF with no embedded e-invoice XML (nothing to extract).\n//! - `500` — database / storage / extraction failure.\n//!\n//! ## Unparsebares eingebettetes XML seit 2026-09-09\n//!\n//! Unparsebares eingebettetes XML ist ein fachliches Ergebnis, kein HTTP-Fehler\n//! (seit 2026-09-09): Wird in einer gespeicherten PDF eingebettetes Factur-X-XML\n//! *gefunden*, scheitert aber [`InvoiceExtractor::extract_pdf_bytes`] am Parsen,\n//! antwortet der Handler weiterhin `200` und persistiert einen leeren `{}`\n//! Payload — exakt der Toleranz-Vertrag, den der Upload-Pfad\n//! (`services/upload.rs::process_pdf_invoice`) für denselben Fall bereits lebt.\n//! Die Antwort trägt zusätzlich `extraction_warning: \"embedded XML unparsable\"`\n//! (additiv). Die reine Entscheidungslogik lebt in [`embedded_xml_outcome`]. Ein\n//! `415` bleibt reserviert für die Fälle, in denen die PDF selbst nicht auf\n//! eingebettetes XML untersucht werden konnte, oder eine direkt gespeicherte XML\n//! nicht geparst werden kann.\n//!\n//! ## Shadow-Ingest nach sgh-acct seit 2026-09-09\n//!\n//! Re-Extraktion spiegelt seit 2026-09-09 nach sgh-acct: nach erfolgreicher\n//! Persistenz in `persist_payload` lädt der Handler die eigene\n//! `invoice_ingest`-Zeile org-gescopt ([`load_ingest_row`]), baut daraus\n//! denselben [`crate::services::acct_shadow::ShadowIngestPayload`] wie der\n//! Upload-Pfad (reine Funktion [`build_shadow_payload`], `ingest_id` =\n//! `invoice_id`) und feuert [`crate::services::acct_shadow::shadow_ingest`]\n//! fire-and-forget per `tokio::spawn`. `shadow_ingest` selbst ist ein No-op\n//! ohne `SGH_ACCT_SHADOW_ENABLED=true` und liefert nie `Err`, ist also nie\n//! fatal für diese Antwort. Die Antwort trägt additiv\n//! `\"shadow_ingest\": \"spawned\"`.\n\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\nuse http::{Request, StatusCode};\nuse hyper::body::Incoming;\nuse serde_json::{Value as JsonValue, json};\nuse uuid::Uuid;\n\nuse sgh_flow_auth::scope;\n\nuse crate::{\n    app::AppContext,\n    server::{\n        auth_extractor::{extract_claims, require_scopes},\n        handler::{\n            HandlerResult, error_response, fetch_s3_bytes_or_404, handler, json_response,\n            parse_invoice_id,\n        },\n        router::insert_route,\n    },\n    services::acct_shadow::{ShadowIngestPayload, shadow_ingest},\n    services::extractor::{InvoiceExtractor, extract_embedded_xml_from_pdf},\n    services::upload::{build_extracted_lines_from_accountgl, derive_amounts_from_payload},\n};\n\n/// Resolve the stored object key for an invoice the caller's organization owns.\n///\n/// Reads `invoice_ingest.storage_path` inside an RLS-scoped transaction so an\n/// invoice owned by another organization yields no row.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `Ok(storage_key)` — the canonical S3 object key.\n/// - `Err(resp)` — a ready-made `404` (not owned / unknown) or `500` (db failure).\n#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]\nasync fn load_storage_key(\n    state: &Arc<AppContext>,\n    invoice_id: Uuid,\n    organization_id: Uuid,\n) -> Result<String, HandlerResult> {\n    let mut tx = match state.db_pool.begin_scoped(organization_id).await {\n        Ok(t) => t,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: begin scoped tx failed\");\n            return Err(error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"database error\",\n            ));\n        }\n    };\n    let row: Option<(String,)> =\n        match sqlx::query_as(\"SELECT storage_path FROM invoice_ingest WHERE id = $1\")\n            .bind(invoice_id)\n            .fetch_optional(&mut *tx)\n            .await\n        {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(err) => {\n                tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: invoice_ingest query failed\");\n                let _ = tx.rollback().await;\n                return Err(error_response(\n                    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                    \"database error\",\n                ));\n            }\n        };\n    if let Err(err) = tx.commit().await {\n        tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: commit scoped read tx failed\");\n        return Err(error_response(\n            StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n            \"database error\",\n        ));\n    }\n    match row {\n        Some((path,)) => Ok(path),\n        None => Err(error_response(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, \"invoice not found\")),\n    }\n}\n\n/// The subset of an `invoice_ingest` row needed to mirror a re-extraction\n/// into `sgh-acct` (§ Shadow-Ingest nach sgh-acct, module docs).\n///\n/// Loaded org-scoped by [`load_ingest_row`]; feeds [`build_shadow_payload`].\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, sqlx::FromRow)]\nstruct IngestRow {\n    id: Uuid,\n    original_filename: String,\n    stored_filename: String,\n    storage_path: String,\n    checksum_hex: String,\n    byte_size: i64,\n    encoding: String,\n}\n\n/// Load the `invoice_ingest` row needed to build a shadow-ingest payload for\n/// an invoice the caller's organization owns.\n///\n/// Mirrors [`load_storage_key`]'s RLS-scoped read pattern but selects every\n/// column [`build_shadow_payload`] needs instead of only `storage_path`.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `Ok(row)` — the ingest row.\n/// - `Err(resp)` — a ready-made `404` (not owned / unknown) or `500` (db\n///   failure).\n#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]\nasync fn load_ingest_row(\n    state: &Arc<AppContext>,\n    invoice_id: Uuid,\n    organization_id: Uuid,\n) -> Result<IngestRow, HandlerResult> {\n    let mut tx = match state.db_pool.begin_scoped(organization_id).await {\n        Ok(t) => t,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: begin scoped tx failed (shadow ingest row)\");\n            return Err(error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"database error\",\n            ));\n        }\n    };\n    let row: Option<IngestRow> = match sqlx::query_as(\n        r#\"SELECT id, original_filename, stored_filename, storage_path, checksum_hex, byte_size, encoding\n           FROM invoice_ingest WHERE id = $1\"#,\n    )\n    .bind(invoice_id)\n    .fetch_optional(&mut *tx)\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: invoice_ingest row query failed (shadow ingest)\");\n            let _ = tx.rollback().await;\n            return Err(error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"database error\",\n            ));\n        }\n    };\n    if let Err(err) = tx.commit().await {\n        tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: commit scoped read tx failed (shadow ingest row)\");\n        return Err(error_response(\n            StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n            \"database error\",\n        ));\n    }\n    match row {\n        Some(r) => Ok(r),\n        None => Err(error_response(StatusCode::NOT_FOUND, \"invoice not found\")),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build the [`ShadowIngestPayload`] mirrored to `sgh-acct` after a\n/// successful re-extraction (§ Shadow-Ingest nach sgh-acct, module docs).\n///\n/// Pure field transcription from `ingest` + the freshly persisted `payload`;\n/// `ingest_id` is set to `ingest.id` (the platform `invoice_ingest.id`, which\n/// equals `invoice_header.id`), never re-derived.\n///\n/// # Arguments\n///\n/// - `ingest` (`&IngestRow`): the loaded `invoice_ingest` row.\n/// - `org` (`Uuid`): the caller's `organization_id`.\n/// - `payload` (`JsonValue`): the freshly extracted, non-empty payload.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// The [`ShadowIngestPayload`] ready for [`shadow_ingest`].\nfn build_shadow_payload(ingest: &IngestRow, org: Uuid, payload: JsonValue) -> ShadowIngestPayload {\n    ShadowIngestPayload {\n        ingest_id: ingest.id,\n        original_filename: ingest.original_filename.clone(),\n        stored_filename: ingest.stored_filename.clone(),\n        storage_path: ingest.storage_path.clone(),\n        checksum_hex: ingest.checksum_hex.clone(),\n        byte_size: ingest.byte_size,\n        encoding: ingest.encoding.clone(),\n        organization_id: org,\n        json_payload: Some(payload),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Outcome of probing a stored PDF for embedded e-invoice XML during\n/// retroactive extraction (§ Unparsebares eingebettetes XML, module docs).\n///\n/// A pure decision over the two independent facts the PDF branch of\n/// [`extract_payload`] observes: whether embedded XML was *found* at all, and\n/// — only when it was — whether it could be *parsed* into a structured\n/// payload.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\nenum ExtractionOutcome {\n    /// Embedded XML was found and parsed into a structured payload.\n    Parsed,\n    /// Embedded XML was found but could not be parsed — a fachliches\n    /// Ergebnis, not an HTTP error: the caller persists an empty payload\n    /// with a warning instead of failing the request.\n    Unparsable,\n    /// No embedded XML was found at all (plain PDF, nothing to extract).\n    NoXml,\n}\n\n/// Classify a PDF's embedded-XML probe into an [`ExtractionOutcome`].\n///\n/// `found` mirrors `extract_embedded_xml_from_pdf(bytes) == Ok(Some(_))`;\n/// `parse_ok` mirrors whether the subsequent\n/// [`InvoiceExtractor::extract_pdf_bytes`] call succeeded. `parse_ok` is\n/// meaningless when `found` is `false` and is ignored in that case.\nfn embedded_xml_outcome(found: bool, parse_ok: bool) -> ExtractionOutcome {\n    match (found, parse_ok) {\n        (true, true) => ExtractionOutcome::Parsed,\n        (true, false) => ExtractionOutcome::Unparsable,\n        (false, _) => ExtractionOutcome::NoXml,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Run the extractor over the stored bytes and return the structured payload.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `Ok((payload, warning))` — `payload` is the structured payload (BAPI +\n///   normalized view), non-empty unless embedded XML was found but could not\n///   be parsed (§ Unparsebares eingebettetes XML, module docs), in which case\n///   `payload` is `{}` and `warning` carries\n///   `Some(\"embedded XML unparsable\")`. `warning` is `None` on a clean parse.\n/// - `Err(resp)` — `422` (plain PDF, no embedded XML, or a payload that\n///   parsed but yielded no fields), `415` (the PDF itself could not be probed\n///   for embedded XML, or a directly-stored XML file could not be parsed), or\n///   `500` (extraction error).\n#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]\nasync fn extract_payload(\n    invoice_id: Uuid,\n    bytes: &[u8],\n    extractor: &InvoiceExtractor,\n) -> Result<(JsonValue, Option<&'static str>), HandlerResult> {\n    if bytes.starts_with(b\"%PDF\") {\n        // Only ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDFs (embedded e-invoice XML) carry structured\n        // data; a plain PDF has nothing to extract here.\n        match extract_embedded_xml_from_pdf(bytes) {\n            Ok(Some(_)) => match extractor.extract_pdf_bytes(bytes).await {\n                Ok(payload) => {\n                    debug_assert_eq!(embedded_xml_outcome(true, true), ExtractionOutcome::Parsed);\n                    if payload.as_object().map(|m| m.is_empty()).unwrap_or(true) {\n                        return Err(error_response(\n                            StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,\n                            \"no structured e-invoice fields could be extracted\",\n                        ));\n                    }\n                    Ok((payload, None))\n                }\n                Err(err) => {\n                    // Fachliches Ergebnis, kein HTTP-Fehler (module docs,\n                    // 2026-09-09): tolerate exactly like the upload path —\n                    // persist an empty payload and surface a warning.\n                    debug_assert_eq!(\n                        embedded_xml_outcome(true, false),\n                        ExtractionOutcome::Unparsable\n                    );\n                    tracing::warn!(%invoice_id, error = %err, \"extract: embedded XML present but unparsable; persisting empty payload\");\n                    Ok((json!({}), Some(\"embedded XML unparsable\")))\n                }\n            },\n            Ok(None) => {\n                debug_assert_eq!(embedded_xml_outcome(false, false), ExtractionOutcome::NoXml);\n                Err(error_response(\n                    StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,\n                    \"PDF has no embedded e-invoice XML (not a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X document)\",\n                ))\n            }\n            Err(err) => {\n                tracing::warn!(%invoice_id, error = %err, \"extract: could not inspect PDF for embedded XML\");\n                Err(error_response(\n                    StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n                    \"could not read embedded XML from stored PDF\",\n                ))\n            }\n        }\n    } else {\n        let payload = extractor.extract_xml_bytes(bytes).await.map_err(|err| {\n            tracing::warn!(%invoice_id, error = %err, \"extract: stored XML could not be parsed\");\n            error_response(\n                StatusCode::UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n                \"stored document is not parseable e-invoice XML\",\n            )\n        })?;\n\n        // A structurally-empty payload means the extractor found no e-invoice content.\n        if payload.as_object().map(|m| m.is_empty()).unwrap_or(true) {\n            return Err(error_response(\n                StatusCode::UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY,\n                \"no structured e-invoice fields could be extracted\",\n            ));\n        }\n        Ok((payload, None))\n    }\n}\n\n/// Persist the freshly extracted payload into the read model (payload row, header\n/// amounts + item count, line items), all scoped to `organization_id`.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// `Ok(line_count)` — number of `invoice_item` rows inserted (newly created).\n///\n/// # Errors\n///\n/// - `Err(resp)` — a ready-made `500` on a database failure that prevents the\n///   payload itself from being stored. Header/item projection failures are\n///   logged but non-fatal (the payload is the source of truth).\n#[allow(clippy::result_large_err)]\nasync fn persist_payload(\n    state: &Arc<AppContext>,\n    invoice_id: Uuid,\n    organization_id: Uuid,\n    storage_key: &str,\n    payload: &JsonValue,\n) -> Result<usize, HandlerResult> {\n    // 1. Upsert the latest invoice_payloads row's json_payload. Update the most\n    //    recent row in place (the read model reads `ORDER BY created_at DESC\n    //    LIMIT 1`); insert a fresh row only when none exists yet.\n    let updated = sqlx::query(\n        r#\"\n        UPDATE invoice_payloads\n        SET json_payload = $1\n        WHERE id = (\n            SELECT id FROM invoice_payloads\n            WHERE ingest_id = $2 AND organization_id = $3\n            ORDER BY created_at DESC\n            LIMIT 1\n        )\n        \"#,\n    )\n    .bind(payload)\n    .bind(invoice_id)\n    .bind(organization_id)\n    .execute(state.db_pool.inner())\n    .await;\n\n    match updated {\n        Ok(r) if r.rows_affected() > 0 => {\n            tracing::info!(%invoice_id, \"extract: updated existing invoice_payloads row\");\n        }\n        Ok(_) => {\n            // No existing row — insert one.\n            if let Err(err) = sqlx::query(\n                r#\"\n                INSERT INTO invoice_payloads (ingest_id, storage_path, json_payload, organization_id)\n                VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)\n                \"#,\n            )\n            .bind(invoice_id)\n            .bind(storage_key)\n            .bind(payload)\n            .bind(organization_id)\n            .execute(state.db_pool.inner())\n            .await\n            {\n                tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: invoice_payloads insert failed\");\n                return Err(error_response(\n                    StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                    \"failed to store extracted payload\",\n                ));\n            }\n            tracing::info!(%invoice_id, \"extract: inserted new invoice_payloads row\");\n        }\n        Err(err) => {\n            tracing::error!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: invoice_payloads update failed\");\n            return Err(error_response(\n                StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n                \"failed to store extracted payload\",\n            ));\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Project header amounts + currency from the payload (reuse the upload\n    //    service's derivation so the rules stay in one place) and reset the\n    //    status to RECEIVED when the invoice was INVALID or NEEDS_REVIEW so it\n    //    becomes AI-eligible again. Non-fatal.\n    let (net, gross, payable, currency) = derive_amounts_from_payload(payload);\n    let line_items = payload\n        .get(\"ACCOUNTGL\")\n        .and_then(|v| v.as_array())\n        .map(|rows| build_extracted_lines_from_accountgl(rows))\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n    let total_items = line_items.len() as i64;\n\n    let net_str = net.map(|d| d.to_string());\n    let gross_str = gross.map(|d| d.to_string());\n    let payable_str = payable.map(|d| d.to_string());\n    let doc_hdr = payload.get(\"DOCUMENTHEADER\");\n    let vendor_name_str = doc_hdr\n        .and_then(|h| h.get(\"VENDOR_NAME\"))\n        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty());\n    let vendor_no_str = doc_hdr\n        .and_then(|h| h.get(\"VENDOR_NO\"))\n        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty());\n    if let Err(err) = sqlx::query(\n        r#\"UPDATE invoice_header\n           SET status         = CASE WHEN status IN ('INVALID'::invoice_status, 'NEEDS_REVIEW'::invoice_status) THEN 'RECEIVED'::invoice_status ELSE status END,\n               net_amount     = CASE WHEN $2::TEXT IS NOT NULL THEN $2::NUMERIC ELSE net_amount END,\n               gross_amount   = CASE WHEN $3::TEXT IS NOT NULL THEN $3::NUMERIC ELSE gross_amount END,\n               payable_amount = CASE WHEN $4::TEXT IS NOT NULL THEN $4::NUMERIC ELSE payable_amount END,\n               currency       = COALESCE($5, currency),\n               total_items    = CASE WHEN $6 > 0 THEN $6 ELSE total_items END,\n               vendor_name    = COALESCE($8, vendor_name),\n               vendor_no      = COALESCE($9, vendor_no),\n               updated_at     = NOW()\n           WHERE id = $1 AND organization_id = $7\"#,\n    )\n    .bind(invoice_id)\n    .bind(net_str.as_deref())\n    .bind(gross_str.as_deref())\n    .bind(payable_str.as_deref())\n    .bind(currency.as_deref())\n    .bind(total_items)\n    .bind(organization_id)\n    .bind(vendor_name_str)\n    .bind(vendor_no_str)\n    .execute(state.db_pool.inner())\n    .await\n    {\n        tracing::warn!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: invoice_header update failed (non-fatal)\");\n    }\n\n    // 3. (Re)insert invoice_item rows from the BAPI ACCOUNTGL section. Idempotent.\n    let mut inserted = 0usize;\n    if !line_items.is_empty() {\n        use crate::db::repositories::invoice_items::{\n            InvoiceItemRepository, SqlxInvoiceItemRepository,\n        };\n        let repo = SqlxInvoiceItemRepository::new(state.db_pool.clone());\n        match repo\n            .insert_extracted_lines(invoice_id, organization_id, &line_items)\n            .await\n        {\n            Ok(n) => {\n                inserted = n;\n                tracing::info!(%invoice_id, lines = n, \"extract: inserted invoice_item rows\");\n            }\n            Err(err) => {\n                tracing::warn!(error = %err, %invoice_id, \"extract: invoice_item insert failed (non-fatal)\");\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(inserted)\n}\n\n// ── Handler ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/// `POST /api/v1/invoices/{invoice_id}/extract`\n///\n/// Re-runs structured field extraction against the already-stored invoice and\n/// persists the result into the read model.\n///\n/// # Returns\n///\n/// - `200 OK` — `{ invoice_id, extracted: true, line_items, seller, currency, gross_amount, extraction_warning, shadow_ingest }`.\n///   `extraction_warning` is `null` on a clean parse and\n///   `\"embedded XML unparsable\"` when embedded XML was found but could not be\n///   parsed (§ Unparsebares eingebettetes XML, module docs). `shadow_ingest`\n///   is `\"spawned\"` once the mirror to `sgh-acct` has been fired\n///   fire-and-forget (§ Shadow-Ingest nach sgh-acct, module docs) —\n///   `shadow_ingest` itself silently no-ops when disabled, so no distinct\n///   `\"skipped\"` state is observable from this response.\n/// - error responses as documented at the module level.\nasync fn extract_impl(\n    req: Request<Incoming>,\n    params: matchit::Params<'static, 'static>,\n    state: Arc<AppContext>,\n) -> HandlerResult {\n    let claims = match extract_claims(&req, &state) {\n        Ok(c) => c,\n        Err(r) => return r,\n    };\n    if let Err(r) = require_scopes(&claims, &[scope::INVOICES_WRITE]) {\n        return r;\n    }\n    let invoice_id = match parse_invoice_id(&params) {\n        Ok(id) => id,\n        Err(r) => return r,\n    };\n    let org_id = claims.organization_id;\n\n    tracing::info!(%invoice_id, org_id = %org_id, actor = %claims.sub, \"retroactive extraction requested\");\n\n    let storage_key = match load_storage_key(&state, invoice_id, org_id).await {\n        Ok(k) => k,\n        Err(r) => return r,\n    };\n    let bytes = match fetch_s3_bytes_or_404(\n        &state.s3_client,\n        invoice_id,\n        &storage_key,\n        \"invoice document not available\",\n    )\n    .await\n    {\n        Ok(b) => b,\n        Err(r) => return r,\n    };\n\n    let extractor = InvoiceExtractor::new();\n    let (payload, extraction_warning) = match extract_payload(invoice_id, &bytes, &extractor).await\n    {\n        Ok(p) => p,\n        Err(r) => return r,\n    };\n\n    let line_items = match persist_payload(&state, invoice_id, org_id, &storage_key, &payload).await\n    {\n        Ok(n) => n,\n        Err(r) => return r,\n    };\n\n    // Shadow-Ingest nach sgh-acct (module docs, § Shadow-Ingest seit\n    // 2026-09-09): niemals fatal für diese Antwort — ein Fehler beim Laden\n    // der ingest-Zeile wird nur geloggt, `shadow_ingest` selbst spawnt\n    // fire-and-forget und liefert nie `Err`.\n    match load_ingest_row(&state, invoice_id, org_id).await {\n        Ok(ingest_row) => {\n            let shadow_payload = build_shadow_payload(&ingest_row, org_id, payload.clone());\n            tokio::spawn(shadow_ingest(shadow_payload));\n        }\n        Err(_) => {\n            tracing::warn!(\n                %invoice_id,\n                org_id = %org_id,\n                \"extract: could not load invoice_ingest row for shadow ingest (non-fatal)\"\n            );\n        }\n    }\n\n    let seller = payload\n        .get(\"seller\")\n        .and_then(|s| s.get(\"name\"))\n        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)\n        .map(str::to_owned);\n    let currency = payload\n        .get(\"document\")\n        .and_then(|d| d.get(\"currency\"))\n        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)\n        .map(str::to_owned);\n    let gross = payload\n        .get(\"totals\")\n        .and_then(|t| t.get(\"tax_inclusive\"))\n        .and_then(|o| o.get(\"value\"))\n        .and_then(JsonValue::as_str)\n        .map(str::to_owned);\n\n    tracing::info!(\n        %invoice_id,\n        org_id = %org_id,\n        line_items,\n        seller = ?seller,\n        extraction_warning = ?extraction_warning,\n        \"retroactive extraction completed\"\n    );\n\n    json_response(\n        StatusCode::OK,\n        &json!({\n            \"invoice_id\": invoice_id,\n            \"extracted\": true,\n            \"line_items\": line_items,\n            \"seller\": seller,\n            \"currency\": currency,\n            \"gross_amount\": gross,\n            \"extraction_warning\": extraction_warning,\n            \"shadow_ingest\": \"spawned\",\n        }),\n    )\n}\n\n// ── Route wrapper + registration ────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nhandler!(extract_handler, extract_impl);\n\n/// Register the retroactive extraction route into the platform
